english: Budjanga lies along the Wearyan River, inland from the southwestern shores of the Gulf of Carpentaria. Its waterholes belong to a chain of named places, with the springs of Doolgarina farther upstream. Some pools hold water when the surrounding country dries, while shallower lagoons disappear with the season. Aboriginal families know these waters through names and journeys passed down by their elders. Moving between camps along the Wearyan and towards the Robinson River calls for knowledge of which pools will last: a familiar bank or spring can mark the next stopping place across this country.
simp_chinese: 布詹加位于卡奔塔利亚湾西南岸内陆的威尔扬河畔。沿河水潭各有其名，上游还有泉水涌出的杜尔加里纳。当周围土地干燥时，一些深潭仍能蓄水，浅洼中的水却会随季节消退。原住民家庭从长辈那里熟悉这些水源的名称和通往各处的道路。沿威尔扬河迁移营地，或向鲁宾逊河一带行进，都须知道哪些水潭能够长久供水；熟悉的河岸与泉眼，便是途中下一处落脚之地。

english: Cache Valley lies in the Bear River country north of the Great Salt Lake, enclosed by mountain ranges and crossed by streams. Shoshone people used the valley and its surrounding lands long before fur hunters arrived. In the winter of 1824–25 American trappers worked along the Bear River and its tributaries; Jim Bridger is associated with an early journey downriver toward the Great Salt Lake. British traders under Peter Skene Ogden also followed the river into this inland basin.
simp_chinese: 卡什谷位于大盐湖北方的贝尔河地区，四周被山脉环绕，溪流穿过谷地。毛皮捕猎者到来很久以前，肖肖尼人便利用谷地及周围土地。1824至1825年冬，美国捕猎者在贝尔河及其支流沿岸活动；吉姆·布里杰曾沿河下行，前往大盐湖。彼得·斯基恩·奥格登率领的英国商人也沿河进入这片内陆盆地。

english: Bueng Boraphet is a broad freshwater wetland east of Nakhon Sawan, near the meeting of the Ping and Nan rivers. Open water and marshes are surrounded by floodplains, and streams carry water into the lake from the east. Lotus and other aquatic plants grow among its shallows, sheltering fish and waterbirds. Seasonal changes in water level reshape the margins of the wetland, which lies within the great Chao Phraya river basin.
simp_chinese: 波拉碧湖是一片宽阔的淡水湿地，位于那空沙旺以东，靠近平河与难河的汇合处。湖水和沼泽周围是洪泛平原，东面的溪流向湖中注水。莲花和其他水生植物生长在浅水区，为鱼类和水鸟提供栖息之地。水位随季节变化，不断改变湿地的边缘；湖区属于广大湄南河流域的一部分。

sources.title: 02ทะเบียนรายนามพื้นที่ชุ่มน้ำEng-3.pdf

english: The Buffalo Head Hills rise above the lowlands east of the Peace River. Northern forest covers their rolling heights, with spruce, pine and poplar among the trees. Streams descend from the hills towards the Loon River lowlands, where broad expanses of muskeg occupy the wetter ground. Glacial deposits mantle much of the landscape, and lakes, marshes and fens lie among the woods and undulating plains to the south.
simp_chinese: 野牛头山丘高出和平河以东的低地。起伏的高处覆盖着北方森林，树木包括云杉、松树和杨树。溪流从山丘流向卢恩河低地，那里湿润的地面上广布泥炭沼泽。冰川沉积物覆盖了大部分地表，南方的林地与波状平原之间则点缀着湖泊、沼泽和湿地。

english:
Guadalajara de Buga stands in the Cauca valley beside the Guadalajara River, between the central and western ranges of the Colombian Andes. Indigenous communities inhabited the valley before Spanish conquest. The colonial town occupied several sites during the sixteenth century before settling in its present valley location. Its streets and churches grew as Buga became a centre for the surrounding agricultural country.

Tradition connects the town with an image of Christ known as the Lord of Miracles, venerated by generations of pilgrims. The principal church was built between the late sixteenth and early seventeenth centuries. In 1811 Buga joined Cali and other Cauca valley towns in a confederation opposing the royalist governor of Popayán. The alliance placed the town in the early struggle over the political future of New Granada.
simp_chinese:
瓜达拉哈拉德布加坐落在哥伦比亚安第斯山中、西两条山脉之间的考卡河谷，瓜达拉哈拉河穿城而过。西班牙征服之前，原住民社群居住在河谷。殖民城镇在十六世纪曾多次迁址，最终在河谷中的城址安定下来。布加成为周围农业地区的中心，街道与教堂随之发展。

地方传统将城镇与称为奇迹之主的基督圣像联系起来，世代朝圣者前来敬奉。主要教堂建于十六世纪末至十七世纪初。1811年，布加与卡利及考卡河谷其他城镇结成联盟，反对波帕扬的保王派总督。这一联盟使布加参与了新格拉纳达政治未来的早期斗争。

sources.title: cali anos de autonomia administrativa pub

english:
Buganda grew from a small kingdom on the northern shore of Lake Victoria into a major power of the Great Lakes. Its ruler, the kabaka, governed through chiefs and a court established on one of the kingdom's hills. Traditions name Kintu as the first kabaka, and tell how he won the hand of Nambi, daughter of the sky deity Ggulu. Banana gardens supplied the kingdom's people, while the lake offered a route to its islands and neighbouring shores.

From the seventeenth century, Buganda expanded beyond its early heartland and strengthened its royal government. Much of its growth came at the expense of Bunyoro, its powerful neighbour to the north and west. The kingdom's chiefs and court helped extend the kabaka's authority over newly incorporated territories, while royal palaces moved between defensible hills as different rulers chose their seats.
simp_chinese:
布干达从维多利亚湖北岸的一个小王国，成长为大湖地区的重要强权。国王称为卡巴卡，通过酋长和设在山丘上的宫廷治理国家。传统称金图为首位卡巴卡，讲述他如何赢得天空神格古鲁之女南比的婚约。香蕉园供养居民，湖面则提供通往岛屿及邻近岸边的水路。

十七世纪起，布干达向早期核心地区之外扩张，并加强王室治理。其扩张很大程度上以北方和西方的强邻布尼奥罗为代价。酋长和宫廷帮助卡巴卡将权威延伸至新纳入的领土；不同统治者选择王座所在地时，王宫也在易于防守的山丘之间迁移。

english: Bugara lies in the northern Karagwe highlands near the Kagera River. Traditions of the kingdom place it on the journey of Ruhinda, the founder associated with the Bahinda dynasty. One account tells how he crossed the Kagera from the north with followers and cattle, settling first at Bugara before moving through the highlands to Bwehange. Stories of Ruhinda differ between kingdoms, but Bugara remained one of the places closely associated with his memory.
simp_chinese: 布加拉位于卡盖拉河附近的卡拉圭北部高地。王国的传统将这里与巴欣达王朝的始祖鲁欣达联系起来。一种说法讲述，他带着追随者和牛群从北方渡过卡盖拉河，先在布加拉定居，随后穿过高地抵达布韦汉盖。各王国关于鲁欣达的故事并不完全相同，但布加拉始终是与他紧密相关的地方之一。

english: Bugat lies in the Gobi Altai country of western Mongolia; its name means “place of deer”. Nearby mountain ranges rise above the arid basins of the Gobi, and the slopes of Alag Khairkhan provide habitat for wild sheep and other animals. The contrast between rocky uplands and the dry plains below gives this western edge of the desert a varied landscape.
simp_chinese: 布嘎特位于蒙古西部的戈壁阿尔泰地区，名称意为“有鹿的地方”。附近山脉高出戈壁干旱盆地，阿拉格海尔汗山坡为野羊等动物提供栖息地。岩石高地与下方干旱平原相映，使荒漠西缘的景观富于变化。

english:
Bugulma takes its name from the Bugulminka River. The Bugulma sloboda is recorded from 1736, on the site of an older small village also called Ilmukhametova. Its growth was linked to the founding of Orenburg and the new road serving that frontier. A 1747 register lists Tatar inhabitants, and in the early 1760s, as Russian administration expanded in the region, the settlement became the center of a newly organized administrative district.

During Yemelyan Pugachev's rebellion the government commander General Bibikov maintained his headquarters in the Bugulma area. Catherine II granted the settlement the status of an uyezd town in 1781, within the Ufa Viceroyalty. Roads through Bugulma connected Kazan with Ufa and Orenburg, giving it a place in the trade of the region.
simp_chinese:
布古利马因布古利明卡河得名。布古利马聚落自1736年起见于记载，原址上曾有一座也称伊尔穆哈梅托瓦的小村庄。奥伦堡的建立及通往边疆的新道路推动了它的发展。1747年的人口登记列有鞑靼居民，1760年代初，随着俄罗斯行政扩展到此地，聚落成为新设辖区的中心。

叶梅利扬·普加乔夫起义期间，政府军总指挥比比科夫将军在布古利马一带设立司令部。1781年，叶卡捷琳娜二世授予聚落县城地位，归入乌法总督区。经过布古利马的道路连接喀山、乌法和奥伦堡，使它在地区贸易中占有一席之地。

english: Bügür is an oasis on the northern edge of the Tarim Basin, between Kucha and Karashahr. Rivers descending from the Tian Shan sustain its fields before reaching the dry country along the Tarim. The district contains ancient fortified sites associated with the Han presence in the Western Regions, when garrisons and cultivated lands guarded the northern road around the Taklamakan. Bügür's position kept it connected to the neighbouring oasis towns.
simp_chinese: 布古尔是塔里木盆地北缘的绿洲，位于龟兹与焉耆之间。天山流下的河水滋养当地田地，再流向塔里木河沿岸的干燥土地。境内古城遗址与汉代经营西域的历史有关，当时驻军和屯田守卫着绕过塔克拉玛干的北道。布古尔所处的位置使它与邻近绿洲城镇保持联系。

english: Buguruslan was founded at the end of 1748 on the right bank of the Bolshoy Kinel, where the Turkhanka joins it. Russian peasants and artisans who had moved into the Volga region established the sloboda on the hereditary lands of the Bashkirs of the Kipchak district of the Nogai road. In 1781 it became an uyezd town within the Ufa Viceroyalty. The new town thus acquired an administrative role in a region where Bashkir landholding and Russian settlement had met.
simp_chinese: 布古鲁斯兰建于1748年末，位于图尔汗卡河汇入大基涅利河处的右岸。迁往伏尔加地区的俄罗斯农民和工匠在诺盖道钦察辖区巴什基尔人的世袭土地上建立了这座聚落。1781年，它成为乌法总督区的县城，在巴什基尔土地持有与俄罗斯移民相交汇的地区获得了行政职能。

english: Buha is the largest river flowing into Qinghai Lake. Its name means “wild yak” in the local dialect, and its tributaries descend from the Qilian Mountains before crossing the high grasslands west of the lake. At the river mouth the fresh water meets the lake's alkaline salt water, creating wetlands in a basin that has no outlet to the sea.
simp_chinese: 布哈河是注入青海湖的最大河流，名称在当地方言中意为“野牦牛”。支流从祁连山流下，穿过湖西的高原草地。在河口，淡水与青海湖的碱性咸水相遇，形成湿地；这座湖盆没有流向大海的出口。

english: Buuhoodle lies on the pastoral plateau between the Haud and the broad Nugaal valley. Grass and thorn scrub cover the country, where herders follow seasonal pasture with their livestock. Water is especially valuable in the dry season, when the shallow drainage channels of the Nugaal no longer carry rainwater.
simp_chinese: 布胡德勒位于豪德与宽阔的努加尔河谷之间的牧业高原。草地与荆棘灌丛覆盖着这一地区，牧民随季节寻找牧草，带着牲畜迁徙。旱季时，努加尔浅水道不再流淌雨水，水源便格外珍贵。

english: The inland country around Builoo lies near the headwaters of the Belyando River in central Queensland. Open woodland and plains extend between the Great Dividing Range and the Drummond Range. Aboriginal peoples of the wider Belyando country include the Yagalingu, whose recorded country encompasses the river’s upper reaches.
simp_chinese: 布伊卢一带的内陆地区位于昆士兰中部贝利安多河源头附近。大分水岭与德拉蒙德山脉之间分布着开阔林地和平原。广大贝利安多地区的原住民族包括雅加林古人；记载中的雅加林古土地涵盖河流上游。

english: Builth grew beside the River Wye and the castle that guarded a crossing in central Wales. Edward I extensively rebuilt the stronghold between 1277 and 1283 during his campaigns against the Welsh princes. In December 1282 Llywelyn ap Gruffudd, the last native Prince of Wales, was killed near Builth. The castle's earthworks remain above the town, marking a place closely tied to the English conquest of Wales.
simp_chinese: 比尔斯在怀伊河及守卫威尔士中部渡口的城堡旁发展起来。1277至1283年，爱德华一世在征讨威尔士诸侯期间大规模重建要塞。1282年12月，最后一位本土威尔士亲王卢埃林·阿普·格里菲兹在比尔斯附近被杀。城堡土垒仍位于镇上方，标示着一处与英格兰征服威尔士紧密相关的地点。

english: Buinovichi lies among the forests and marshes of Polesia, northeast of Lelchytsy. Known from the sixteenth century, it belonged to the Ubort estate held by the bishops of Vilnius. A boundary act of 1622 described a line cut through the marshes from the lands of Buinovichi and Stodolichi towards the little Slovechanka River. In 1774 the villagers built a new church after the previous one burned. The estate passed under Russian rule after the partitions of the Commonwealth and was divided in 1808, when Buinovichi was bought by Mikhail Dobrinsky.
simp_chinese: 布伊诺维奇坐落在波列西亚的森林与沼泽之间，位于列利奇齐东北方。村庄自十六世纪见于记载，属于维尔纽斯主教持有的乌博尔季庄园。1622年的划界文书描述了一条从布伊诺维奇与斯托多利奇土地出发、穿过沼泽通向小斯洛韦昌卡河的界线。1774年，原教堂烧毁后，村民修建了新教堂。联邦遭瓜分后，庄园归俄国统治；1808年乌博尔季庄园被分割，布伊诺维奇由米哈伊尔·多布林斯基购得。

english: Buir Nuur is a country of open grassland and freshwater on the eastern Mongolian steppe. The Khalkh River enters the lake through a delta of reeds and wet meadows, and the Orshuun carries its waters north. In 1388 a Ming army under Lan Yu surprised the Northern Yuan camp near the lake. Tögüs Temür escaped, but many of his followers were captured, and the defeat marked a severe blow to the Mongol court that had withdrawn into the steppe after the fall of the Yuan capital.
simp_chinese: 捕鱼儿海位于蒙古东部草原，是一片开阔草地与淡水相间的地区。喀尔喀河流经芦苇和湿草甸构成的三角洲注入湖中，乌尔逊河则将湖水向北带走。1388年，蓝玉率明军在湖畔突袭北元营地。脱古思帖木儿逃脱，许多部众却被俘；自元朝都城陷落后退入草原的蒙古朝廷遭到沉重打击。

english: Buitrago del Lozoya occupies a bend in the Lozoya River, its old town protected by water on three sides and enclosed by medieval walls. The castle and fortified town became associated with the powerful Mendoza family, lords of Buitrago and the neighbouring lands. Their residence combined defensive features with the comforts of a noble house. During the Peninsular War Napoleonic troops occupied and looted the castle in 1808, bringing destruction to this mountain stronghold north of Madrid.
simp_chinese: 布伊特拉戈德洛索亚坐落在洛索亚河曲流处，老城三面临水，并由中世纪城墙环抱。城堡和设防城镇与势力强大的门多萨家族紧密相连，他们是布伊特拉戈及邻近土地的领主。家族府邸兼具防御设施与贵族住宅的舒适。半岛战争期间，拿破仑军队于1808年占领并劫掠城堡，使马德里以北这座山地要塞遭受破坏。

english: Buiunda lies in the upper Buyunda country, east of the Kolyma. The Buyunda flows north through the Kolyma highlands to meet the larger river from the right. Larch forests grow in the upper Kolyma basin, where river valleys lie between cold mountain ridges.
simp_chinese: 布云达位于布云达河上游地区，在科雷马河以东。布云达河穿过科雷马高地向北流，从右岸汇入大河。科雷马河上游流域的河谷分布在寒冷的山岭之间，生长着落叶松林。

english: The Bujang Valley lies between Mount Jerai and the Muda River on the western Malay Peninsula. Its rivers once gave ships access to a busy trading region, where imported goods and local products passed between the coast and inland settlements. Brick and stone sanctuaries, known as candi, stand among the remains of communities linked to Hindu and Buddhist traditions. Bujang flourished over many centuries before the rise of Malacca. Finds of pottery, ornaments and religious images reveal connections with India and the wider maritime world. Buddhist foundations continued into the later medieval period, and the valley's changing settlements formed part of the long history of Kedah's trade across the Strait of Malacca.
simp_chinese: 布秧谷地位于马来半岛西部日莱山与姆达河之间。河流曾让船只驶入繁忙的贸易地区，进口货物与当地物产在海岸和内陆聚落之间流通。称作「钱迪」的砖石神庙留存于古代社群遗址之中，显示其与印度教、佛教传统的联系。马六甲兴起之前，布秧已繁荣了许多世纪。陶器、饰品与宗教造像显示了它同印度及更广阔海上世界的联系。佛教圣所延续至中世纪后期，谷地不断变化的聚落也是吉打跨越马六甲海峡贸易悠久历史的一部分。

sources.title: port and polity of the malay peninsula and sumatra.pdf

english: Buk is an old town west of Poznań, once held by its bishops and cathedral clergy. A document of 1257 records the grant of the village and a town established on its lands to the cathedral's custodian. Craftsmen organised themselves into guilds: butchers, tailors and shoemakers were recorded in the fifteenth century. Buk also produced cloth, including black and grey varieties listed in 1508; the bishops of Poznań granted privileges to its clothmakers and confirmed their guild ordinances in the sixteenth century.
simp_chinese: 布克是波兹南以西的一座古镇，曾属于波兹南主教和主教座堂的教士。1257年的文书记载，村庄及其土地上建立的城镇被授予主教座堂的司库。工匠们组织起行会：十五世纪的记载提到屠夫、裁缝和鞋匠行会。布克也生产呢绒，1508年的清单列有黑色与灰色的产品；十六世纪，波兹南主教向当地呢绒工匠授予特权并确认其行会章程。

english: Buka is a forested island north of Bougainville, separated from it by the narrow Buka Passage. Communities on its shores occupied a strategic position between the Solomon Islands chain and the Bismarck Sea. In 1768 Louis Antoine de Bougainville sailed through the surrounding region; the islands already supported established communities connected by sea and along their coasts.
simp_chinese: 布卡是布干维尔以北的一座森林岛屿，两岛之间隔着狭窄的布卡海峡。沿岸社群所处位置介于所罗门群岛岛链与俾斯麦海之间。1768年，路易·安托万·德·布干维尔航经周边地区；岛上社群早已建立，并通过海路与沿岸往来相连。

english:
Bukachacha lies in the Transbaikal interior of eastern Siberia, where woodland, hills and long continental winters surround a small valley settlement. This thinly populated country is hard to cross: snow, freezing temperatures and distance between settlements shaped the practical work of moving goods and people through the district.

The surrounding country was home to Evenki hunters and herders and Mongol-speaking pastoralists, and part of the old Mongol world. Russian Cossacks reached the Transbaikal in the 1640s and founded Nerchinsk in 1653; the 1689 Treaty of Nerchinsk fixed the frontier with Qing China to the east and south. From 1704 the silver and lead mines of the Nerchinsk region drew convict and peasant labour to the district, tying even remote valleys to a wider system of forced labour.
simp_chinese:
布卡恰恰位于西伯利亚东部的外贝加尔内陆，林地、丘陵和漫长的大陆性冬季环绕着这一小型河谷聚落。在这片人口稀疏的土地上，它的位置适合作为聚集劳力和运输货物的地方。积雪、严寒以及聚落之间漫长的距离，决定了人员和货物在这一地区流动时的实际困难。

周围地区是鄂温克猎人和牧人以及蒙古语牧民的家园，也是古代蒙古世界的一部分。俄国哥萨克于1640年代抵达外贝加尔，并在1653年建立涅尔琴斯克；1689年《尼布楚条约》确定了同清朝在东面和南面的边界。自1704年起，涅尔琴斯克地区的银铅矿把流放犯和农民劳力带到这一带，使即便偏远的山谷也被纳入更广泛的强制劳动体系。

english: Bukan lies near the Simineh River south of Lake Urmia, where the Kurdish highlands give way to the lake's broad basin. The river rises in the Zagros north of Saqqez and flows past the town before reaching the lake. Fields and settlements follow its course through a landscape of hills and pasture, alongside the neighbouring valley of the Zarrineh River.
simp_chinese: 布坎位于乌尔米耶湖以南的西米内河附近，库尔德高地在此向宽阔的湖盆过渡。河流发源于萨盖兹以北的扎格罗斯山脉，流经城镇后注入湖中。田地与聚落沿河分布在丘陵和牧场之间，东面与之相邻的是扎里内河谷。

sources.title: 1959 Central Asian Review Vol 7, Nos. 1, 2, 3 and 4 s.pdf

english: Bukatatonoa lies among the reefs of the Lau region in eastern Fiji. These low coral formations stand in waters crossed by voyagers travelling between the islands of Fiji and Tonga. The Lau group includes volcanic islands as well as reefs and coral-capped platforms, separated by channels of deep water. Navigating among them required attention to the position of reefs and the passages between islands.
simp_chinese: 布卡塔托诺阿位于斐济东部劳群岛一带的礁区。往来斐济与汤加诸岛的航海者会穿越这些低矮珊瑚礁所在的海域。劳群岛既有火山岛，也有礁石和覆有珊瑚的台地，其间隔着深水航道。航行于其间，必须留意礁石的位置和岛屿之间的通道。

english:
Bukawa occupies the north coast of the Huon Gulf, where narrow beaches lie below steep forested ridges rising inland from the sea. Villages clustered around sheltered landings at Cape Arkona and Busama, using canoes to fish, trade and visit neighboring communities. The sea and the mountains created two complementary worlds: marine resources and coastal travel on one side, gardens, timber and hunting on the other.

Austronesian-speaking communities had settled this coast long before 1337, and local histories tied villages through kinship, marriage and canoe routes. Settlement was dispersed and political authority remained local. Coastal groups exchanged fish, shells and crafted goods for inland food and forest materials; the Huon Gulf’s deep water and mountain backdrop made travel easier by boat than across the ranges.

Many villages retained their own speech and names within a shared coastal network. Their everyday world was defined by fishing, gardens, intermarriage and movement around Cape Arkona rather than by a single urban center.
simp_chinese:
布卡瓦位于休恩湾北岸，狭窄海滩背靠从海边陡然升起的森林山脊。村庄围绕阿尔科纳角和布萨马的避风登陆点聚集，人们乘独木舟捕鱼、交易和走亲访友。海洋与山地形成互补的两类世界：一边提供水产和沿岸航路，另一边提供园圃、木材与猎物。

早在1337年以前，南岛语社群已定居这条海岸，地方历史通过亲缘、婚姻和舟行路线把村落联系起来。聚落分布分散，政治权力也保持在地方尺度。沿岸群体用鱼、贝壳和手工艺品交换内陆食物及林产；休恩湾的深水和山岭使沿海南下往往比翻越山脊更容易。

许多村落仍保存各自的方言与名称，同时共享沿岸网络。捕鱼、园圃、通婚和环绕阿尔科纳角的舟行，构成日常生活的基本尺度。

english: Pukch'ŏng lies on a broad coastal plain watered by the Namdae River and its tributaries, one of the most productive agricultural districts of Hamgyŏng. The town received its present name in 1417, distinguishing it from another Ch'ŏngju farther south. During the Japanese invasion of 1592, Katō Kiyomasa's forces advanced into Hamgyŏng; resistance and the harsh winter contributed to their withdrawal from the province early the following year.
simp_chinese: 北青位于宽广的沿海平原，南大川及其支流滋润着田野，使此地成为咸镜道重要的农业区。1417年，朝廷为区别南方另一处清州，将当地改称北青。1592年日本入侵时，加藤清正率军进入咸镜道；抵抗与严冬等因素促使日军在次年年初撤离该道。

english: Bukelon occupies a hill above the Tundzha valley in eastern Thrace, north of Adrianople. Its medieval tower rose upon the foundations of an older fortified site, and pottery from the town on the hill reveals connections with Adrianople and Didymoteichon. In 1205 the Bulgarian tsar Kaloyan defeated a Latin army in the country between Bukelon and Adrianople, capturing Emperor Baldwin of Flanders. Ottoman records of the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries also mention military households living near the fortress, heirs to older local traditions of service.
simp_chinese: 布凯隆坐落在色雷斯东部通扎河谷上方的山丘，位于阿德里安堡以北。中世纪塔楼建在更古老的设防遗址之上，山上聚落出土的陶器显示这里与阿德里安堡、季季莫蒂洪有所联系。1205年，保加利亚沙皇卡洛扬在布凯隆与阿德里安堡之间击败拉丁军队，俘虏佛兰德的鲍德温皇帝。十五、十六世纪的奥斯曼文献还提到堡垒附近的军役人户，他们继承了当地更早的服役传统。

english: The waters off Anastasia Bay lie in the western Bering Sea, where the Koryak coast is cut by deep inlets. Beyond the narrow shelf the sea floor drops steeply and submarine valleys incise the continental slope. Near Cape Navarin the Bering Slope Current divides, sending water toward the Anadyr Current and south along Kamchatka.
simp_chinese: 阿纳斯塔西娅湾外的海域位于白令海西部，科里亚克海岸被深邃的海湾切开。狭窄大陆架之外，海底陡然下降，海底峡谷切入大陆坡；纳瓦林角附近的白令海陆坡流分为两支，一支流向阿纳德尔洋流，另一支沿堪察加向南流去。

english: Lavrova Bay is a fjord on the northwestern side of Olyutor Gulf, at the base of the Govena Peninsula. High slopes of the Pylginsky Range enclose its waters, and the Mechta, Gitkoyulin and Bely streams descend into the bay. Along this part of the Bering Sea coast, steep mountains fall toward a narrow strip of sand and pebbles.
simp_chinese: 拉夫罗夫湾是奥柳托尔湾西北侧的一处峡湾，位于戈韦纳半岛根部。珀尔金山脉高耸的山坡环绕湾水，梅奇塔、吉特科尤林和别雷等溪流从山上汇入。白令海这段海岸的陡峭山地直逼海边，只留下一条狭窄的沙砾滩。

english: Mutnaya Bay opens onto the Pacific on the southeastern coast of Kamchatka, south of Avacha Bay. Rivers descend from the volcanic peninsula toward its shore; the Mutnaya and Asacha are separated inland by the Pemzovy Ridge. At the southern edge of the bay stands the offshore rock of Sivuchy Kamen, a landmark along this rugged coast.
simp_chinese: 穆特纳亚湾位于堪察加半岛东南岸，阿瓦恰湾以南，面向太平洋。河流从火山半岛的内陆流向海岸；穆特纳亚河与阿萨恰河的流域由彭佐维山脊分隔。海湾南缘外海矗立着锡武奇卡缅礁石，是这段崎岖海岸的地标。

english: Ossora Bay opens into the Litke Strait on the mainland side of Karaginsky Gulf. It is one of several bays cutting into northeastern Kamchatka's Bering Sea coast, opposite Karaginsky Island. The bay offers deep, sheltered water, while herring and other fish inhabit the strait and the wider gulf beyond it.
simp_chinese: 奥索拉湾位于卡拉金斯基湾大陆一侧，通向利特克海峡。它是堪察加东北部白令海海岸上的众多海湾之一，与卡拉金斯基岛隔水相望。湾内水深且较为隐蔽，鲱鱼和其他鱼类栖息于海峡以及外侧更宽阔的海湾中。

english: Buki lies on Selayar Island south of the Sulawesi mainland. Its eastern coast faces the Gulf of Bone and the island waters beyond, with rocky cliffs along parts of the shore. The island was home to fortified communities; at Barunia inland from the coast, inhabitants moved to a defended site in the late eighteenth century amid growing pressure from the Dutch East India Company.
simp_chinese: 布基位于苏拉威西大陆以南的塞拉亚尔岛。东岸面向博内湾及外海水域，部分海岸有岩崖。岛上曾有设防社群；十八世纪末，沿岸居民面对荷兰东印度公司日益加重的压力，迁往内陆的巴鲁尼亚设防地点。

english:
Bukino belongs to Kwango in the southwestern Democratic Republic of the Congo, between the central Congo forest and the southern savanna borderlands. The Kwango River forms part of the frontier with Angola and provided fish, water and canoe routes. Wooded grassland supported millet, cassava, livestock and hunting.

Bantu communities organized the country through clan villages and chiefs, while markets exchanged salt, cloth, iron and food. The lower Kwango connected the interior with the Kingdom of Kongo and Atlantic traders, and canoe traffic followed the river through rapids and sandbanks. Local authorities collected dues from passage and trade.

Seasonal rain determined farming and movement between higher ground and river valleys. Bukino’s identity belongs to this wooded frontier where Central African communities, river trade and the Atlantic world met before later provincial boundaries. Palm oil and fish entered canoe trade. Fishing and hunting supplemented cassava and sorghum gardens. Forest honey and palm cloth entered regional markets. Fishing pools remained after the main channel fell. Palm oil supplemented grain trade. River sandbars shifted seasonally. Fishing supplemented forest farming. River ferries linked markets. Fish camps. Ferries.
simp_chinese:
布基诺属于刚果民主共和国西南部的宽果地区，处在中部刚果森林与南部草原边境之间。宽果河构成同安哥拉边界的一部分，提供鱼类、水源和独木舟路线。疏林草地支持黍、木薯、牲畜与狩猎。

班图社群通过氏族村落和酋长组织乡土，市场交换盐、布匹、铁与食物。下宽果河连接内地、刚果王国和大西洋商人，独木舟沿急流与沙洲穿行，地方权威向来往贸易收费。

季节降雨决定农耕以及高地和河谷间的移动。布基诺身份属于这一林木边疆，在中非社群、河运与大西洋世界相遇之处，后来行政边界方才形成。棕榈油和鱼类进入独木舟贸易，旱季草地吸引内陆牧民。捕鱼和狩猎补充木薯、高粱园圃，跨河贸易连接刚果与安哥拉边境。森林蜂蜜和棕榈织物进入区域市场，大西洋贸易又带来盐与金属。主河道退落后仍留有鱼塘。棕榈油补充谷物贸易。河中沙洲随季节移动。捕鱼补充林地农耕。

english: Bukiyip is a Papuan language of northern New Guinea, spoken in the Torricelli Mountains north of the Sepik basin. Forested hills rise between the river plain and the coast, with gardens and villages scattered across the slopes. The language belongs to the diverse linguistic world of the Torricelli region, where neighbouring communities have maintained distinct speech and traditions.
simp_chinese: 布基伊普语是新几内亚北部的一种巴布亚语言，分布在塞皮克流域以北的托里切利山地。森林山丘在河流平原与海岸之间升起，山坡散布着园地与村落。它属于托里切利地区多样的语言世界，邻近社群各自保有不同语言和传统。

english: Bucov lies east of Ploiești in the foothill country of Wallachia, near roads leading from the plain toward the Carpathians. The medieval settlement is securely recorded in a document of 1473. Its position brought it into the struggles of princes and armies moving across the region. In 1600 Michael the Brave, returning to Wallachia after his campaigns in Transylvania and Moldavia, was defeated near Bucov by a Polish and Moldavian force. The encounter formed part of the abrupt collapse of his rule over the three lands.
simp_chinese: 布科夫位于普洛耶什蒂以东的瓦拉几亚山麓，靠近从平原通往喀尔巴阡山的道路。1473年的文献明确记载了这座中世纪聚落。它的位置使其卷入诸侯和军队穿行当地时的争斗。1600年，勇敢的米哈伊在特兰西瓦尼亚和摩尔达维亚的战役后返回瓦拉几亚，在布科夫附近被波兰与摩尔达维亚军队击败。这场战斗是他对三地的统治迅速瓦解过程的一部分。

english: Buksunda is the name of the upper Sugoy, a river that crosses the Kolyma Highlands to join the Kolyma from the right. Its tributaries descend through upland valleys, among them the Elekchan and Omchikchan. The river belongs to a country of forest and northern hills, where Even reindeer herders have long travelled between seasonal pastures and the waterways remain frozen through the long winter.
simp_chinese: 布克松达是苏戈伊河上游的名称。这条河穿过科雷马高地，从右岸注入科雷马河。支流沿高地河谷流下，其中包括埃列克昌河与奥姆奇昌河。河流所在的地区遍布森林和北方丘陵，埃文驯鹿牧民长久以来在季节性牧场之间迁徙，水道则在漫长冬季冰封。

english: The Bulbukhta flows through the Patom mountain country in the basin of the Zhuya and Chara. Its tributaries cut narrow valleys between ridges, where larch, pine and spruce grow beneath slopes covered with dwarf Siberian pine. The Chara eventually joins the Olyokma, carrying the waters of this inland highland to the Lena. The rivers change sharply between winter ice and the summer melt.
simp_chinese: 布尔布赫塔河流经帕托姆山地，属于朱亚河与恰拉河流域。支流在山岭之间切出狭窄河谷，落叶松、松树和云杉生长在谷底，山坡覆盖偃松。恰拉河最终汇入厄廖克马河，将这片内陆高地的水流送往勒拿河。河流在冬季冰封与夏季融冻之间变化鲜明。

english: Bula lies on the northeastern shore of Seram, where the coast faces the islands and waterways of the eastern Moluccas. The long island rises into a mountainous interior behind the coastal plain. To the east, island communities exchanged goods across the seas between Seram, Kei and Aru, carrying forest and marine products through a network of local and visiting traders.
simp_chinese: 布拉位于塞兰岛东北岸，面向摩鹿加东部的岛屿与水道。狭长的岛屿在沿海平原之后升为多山的内陆。东面的岛屿社群穿越塞兰、凯和阿鲁之间的海域交换货物，由本地与外来商人组成的网络运送森林和海洋物产。

english: Bula was a royal seat in the Kongo country northwest of Mbanza Kongo. During the kingdom's civil wars, rival claimants established courts in different places, including Bula, Kibangu and the old capital. Bula was also known as Lemba. In the late seventeenth century it served as the residence of one of the contenders for the Kongo throne.
simp_chinese: 布拉是刚果地区的一处王室驻地，位于姆班扎刚果西北。王国内战期间，争夺王位的各方在不同地点建立王庭，其中包括布拉、基邦古和旧都。布拉也称伦巴；十七世纪末，它是刚果王位争夺者之一的驻地。

sources.title: 312375299 Nouveaux regards sur la demographie du bassin de l'Inkisi a l'epoque du royaume Kongo XVIe - XVIIIe siecle

english:
The Bulaka reaches the sea through the low, wet country of southern Papua. Its mouth opens toward the Arafura coast, where river silt, tidal channels and mangrove forest blur the boundary between fresh and salt water. Annual monsoonal rain feeds a broad drainage system, but the estuary itself is shaped by tides, sediment and shifting banks.

In the thirteenth to early nineteenth centuries, the river was most useful as a transport route. Canoes could carry people and goods between interior settlements and coastal waters, while fish and forest foods supported communities on both sides. Shallow approaches and changing sandbars made local knowledge essential; a bank that could be crossed at one tide might close another channel.

The lower Bulaka also belongs to a linguistic borderland. The Bulaka River languages Yelmek and Maklew are associated with the river’s watershed, while Ndom is spoken farther west on Yos Sudarso Island. Their presence shows that movement along this coast joined communities with distinct local languages, even where the historical record says little about named ports.
simp_chinese:
布拉卡河穿过巴布亚南部低湿的陆地入海。河口面向阿拉弗拉海岸，河流泥沙、潮汐水道和红树林使淡水与咸水之间没有清晰界线。全年季风降雨支撑起广阔流域，河口本身则由潮水、沉积物和不断移动的沙洲塑形。

从十四世纪到十九世纪前期，这条河最重要的作用是交通。独木舟把人口和货物运往内陆聚落与沿海水域，鱼类和林产则供养两岸社群。浅水入口与变化不定的沙洲要求人们熟悉本地环境；一处沙脊可能在一个潮时能够越过，在另一个潮时却封住通道。

布拉卡河下游也处在语言交界带。与流域相联系的布拉卡河语群包括耶尔梅克语和马克莱乌语，恩多姆语则更西，使用于约斯苏达索岛。这说明沿岸往来把使用不同地方语言的社群联系起来，尽管史料很少记载具体港口的名称。

english: Bulakan lies in the Banggai country of eastern Sulawesi, among the lands associated with Saluan communities. Local traditions connect it and neighbouring Lingketeng with the Tompotika mountains. Forested ridges descend towards the coasts of Sulawesi's eastern peninsula, where communities faced the Gulf of Tomini and the islands of Banggai.
simp_chinese: 布拉坎位于苏拉威西东部邦盖地区，是与萨卢安人社群相联系的土地之一。当地传统将它和邻近的林克滕与通波蒂卡山地联系起来。森林山脊向半岛海岸下降，当地社群面向托米尼湾及邦盖诸岛。

english: Bulamu lies in the dry inland country near the borderlands of the Northern Territory and Queensland. The wider region contains open plains, stony rises and seasonal waterways. A regional map places Bulamu among the many Aboriginal language groups of the desert channels and adjoining uplands.
simp_chinese: 布拉穆位于北领地与昆士兰交界一带的干旱内陆。广大地区有开阔平原、石质高地和季节性水道。一份区域地图将布拉穆列在荒漠水道及邻近高地的众多原住民语言群体之中。

english: Bulava is an Ulch settlement beside the lower Amur, where fishing and hunting sustained the people of the river and the surrounding forests. Local tradition connects its name with a shaman's staff, called a bulau in the Ulch language. Stories tell of a shaman who used his staff in healing and appealed to the spirits of the forest and the water for success in hunting and fishing. The wide Amur carries these waters towards its distant estuary.
simp_chinese: 布拉瓦是黑龙江下游的一处乌尔奇人聚居地，捕鱼和狩猎维系着江岸及周围森林中的居民。当地传说将地名与萨满的法杖联系起来，乌尔奇语称这种法杖为“布劳”。故事中的萨满用法杖治病，并向森林和水中的神灵祈求狩猎、捕鱼顺利。宽阔的黑龙江继续向远方河口流去。

english:
Bulbancha is the Choctaw name for New Orleans, a place where many languages meet. The bend of the Mississippi near its mouth lies between the river and Lake Pontchartrain, amid waterways that Indigenous people used long before French settlement. Bayous and portages linked the river with the lake and the Gulf.

The French founded New Orleans in 1718, choosing a site on high ground beside the river. Its position gave it access to both the Mississippi interior and the Gulf, and it became the capital of French Louisiana in 1722. People of Indigenous, African and European origins shaped the port as commerce grew. Spain took possession in the later eighteenth century, before Louisiana passed briefly back to France and was sold to the United States in 1803.
simp_chinese:
布尔班查是新奥尔良的乔克托语名称，意为多种语言汇聚的地方。密西西比河接近河口处有一道弯，土地位于大河与庞恰特雷恩湖之间；早在法国人定居以前，原住民就使用这里的水道。河汊与陆上搬运道路将大河、湖泊和墨西哥湾连接起来。

1718年，法国人在河畔较高处建立新奥尔良。城址既能通往密西西比河内陆，也能通向海湾，1722年成为法属路易斯安那的首府。随着商业发展，原住民、非洲裔和欧洲裔居民共同塑造了这座港口。十八世纪后期西班牙接管路易斯安那，此地随后短暂归还法国，并于1803年售予美国。

english: Buleda lies in a valley north of Turbat, beyond the mountain ridge that separates it from the Kech valley. Cultivation is possible in the valley despite the aridity of the surrounding Makran ranges. The Buledai rulers took their name from this country and became an important power in Makran during the seventeenth century. Their chiefs were associated with the Zikri religious community, whose following spread through the region under their patronage. The fortunes of the valley were thus tied to a dynasty whose influence extended well beyond its mountain home.
simp_chinese: 布莱达位于图尔巴特以北的山谷中，一道山岭将它与凯奇河谷隔开。尽管周围马克兰山脉干旱，谷地中仍有土地可以耕作。布莱达伊统治者得名于此，并在十七世纪成为马克兰的重要势力。他们的首领与齐克里宗教社群关系密切，该信仰在他们庇护下传遍地区。山谷的命运因此与一个影响远及山区之外的王朝紧密相连。

english: The Bulgan River rises on the southern slopes of the Mongolian Altai and flows through a broad valley toward the Ulungur basin. Its channels, wetlands and riverside thickets make a ribbon of life through the dry mountains and plains. Waterbirds rest along the river, while beavers inhabit wooded stretches of its banks. Beyond the mountains the river continues westward across the arid country toward Lake Ulungur.
simp_chinese: 布尔根河发源于蒙古阿尔泰南坡，流过宽阔河谷，向乌伦古盆地而去。河道、湿地与岸边灌木林在干旱山地和平原中形成一条生机带。水鸟在河边停歇，河狸栖息于林木茂密的河岸。河水越过山地后继续西流，奔向乌伦古湖。

english: Buli Bay cuts into the eastern coast of Halmahera between two of the island's long peninsulas. It opens towards the Halmahera Sea, with mountainous land enclosing its shores. Along with Kao and Weda bays, it gives the large island its deeply indented shape, dividing its arms with broad reaches of sea.
simp_chinese: 布利湾凹入哈马黑拉东岸，位于岛屿两条狭长半岛之间。海湾向哈马黑拉海敞开，山地环抱两岸。它与高湾、韦达湾共同塑造这座大岛深入曲折的轮廓，宽阔海水将岛屿的各条半岛分开。

english:
Bulik lies along the upper Lamandau River, where forested hills drain toward the lowlands of southwestern Borneo. Nanga Bulik grew at a river landing used by Ngaju Dayak communities and Malay traders, with canoes carrying timber, rattan, resins and food between scattered longhouse settlements and downstream markets.

During the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries this part of the Lamandau basin was drawn into trade associated with Majapahit and coastal Bornean polities. Islam spread through Malay and Bugis networks by the seventeenth century, when Kotawaringin emerged as a sultanate upstream on the river. The ruler depended on forest produce, river tolls and the loyalty of local chiefs, while conversion and commerce reshaped the contacts between interior communities and the coast.

Kotawaringin’s authority remained loose across the forested hinterland. People combined swidden farming, hunting and gathering with canoe trade, and settlements shifted with exhausted soils and changing river courses. Nanga Bulik’s later role as an administrative center grew from this older junction of river transport and forest exchange.
simp_chinese:
布利克位于拉曼达乌河上游，森林丘陵的溪水从这里流向婆罗洲西南部低地。南加布利克兴起于一处河岸停泊地，恩加朱达雅克社群与马来商人由此往来，独木舟把木材、藤、树脂和食物从分散的长屋聚落运往下游市场。

十四、十五世纪间，拉曼达乌河流域已进入与满者伯夷及婆罗洲沿海政权有关的贸易网络。到十七世纪，伊斯兰教随马来和布吉商人传播，哥打瓦林因也在河流上游发展为苏丹国。统治者依靠林产、河税和地方首领的效忠，改宗与商业则不断重塑内陆社群同海岸的关系。

苏丹国对森林腹地的控制始终较为松散。人们兼营轮耕、狩猎采集和舟运，聚落会随地力耗尽和河道变化而迁移。南加布利克后来成为行政中心，正源于这处更早形成的河运与林产交换节点。

english: Buljigu is a recorded name for a northern variety of Ngadju speech in the inland country of southwestern Australia. The Ngadju inhabited a broad region of woodland, salt lakes and dry plains north of the southern coast. Their country adjoined those of other Aboriginal peoples whose languages and names reflected longstanding connections across the region.
simp_chinese: 布尔吉古是澳大利亚西南部内陆恩加朱语北部变体的记录名称。恩加朱人居住在南岸以北由林地、盐湖和干燥平原构成的广阔地区。他们的土地与其他原住民人群的土地相邻，各自语言和名称反映了区域内长期的联系。

english: Lake Buluan lies in the low interior of Mindanao, amid marshy basins associated with the Pulangi, Maanoy, Buluan and Alah rivers. The Buluan River carries water from the lake towards the Liguasan Marsh and the Mindanao River. Before American rule the lake was surrounded by lands of the Sultanate of Buayan.
simp_chinese: 布卢安湖位于棉兰老岛低平的内陆，周围是普兰吉、马阿诺伊、布卢安和阿拉河相连的沼泽盆地。布卢安河将湖水送往利瓜桑沼泽和棉兰老河。美国统治以前，湖泊周围是布阿延苏丹国的领地。

english:
Buluguda belongs to traditional Badimaya country in Western Australia’s Mid West. Norman Tindale estimated the homeland at about 11,300 square miles, reaching Cue, Nannine and Mount Magnet in the north, Paynes Find in the south and Yalgoo toward the southwest. The northwest boundary lay along the Sandford River. Western Desert language groups bordered the country east, while Noongar and Watjarri communities lived to the southwest and northwest. Badimaya is a language of the Kartu branch within the Pama–Nyungan family. The people were reported to practise both circumcision and subincision.

This inland country therefore carries language and law. The wide country extends from the Mount Magnet area toward Paynes Find and Yalgoo. Granite rock holes stored water after rain. Seasonal movement linked waterholes, hunting grounds and stone deposits.
simp_chinese:
布卢古达位于西澳大利亚中西部巴迪马亚人的传统地域。诺曼·廷代尔估算故土约1.13万平方英里，北至丘、纳宁与芒特马格尼特，南至佩恩斯芬德，西南方向到亚尔古，西北边界沿桑福德河展开。东面与西部沙漠语言群体相邻，西南和西北分别邻近努恩加人与瓦贾里人的地区。巴迪马亚语属于帕马—恩永甘语系中的卡尔图语支。资料记载，当地传统包含割礼与包皮下切开术。

这片内陆地域因而承载着语言与法度。这片辽阔故土从芒特马格尼特一带延伸到佩恩斯芬德和亚尔古。花岗岩上的岩穴在雨后蓄水。季节性迁徙把水潭、猎场与石料产地联系起来。

english: Bulun stands at the mouth of the Tatta, where that river meets the Aldan in central Yakutia. The Tatta crosses the lowland from the south, collecting the waters of a landscape dotted with lakes and woodland. At its confluence the broad Aldan continues toward the Lena, tying this river country to the great northern drainage system. Long winters freeze the waterways before the spring thaw.
simp_chinese: 布伦位于雅库特中部塔塔河汇入阿尔丹河的河口。塔塔河从南方穿越低地，汇集湖泊与森林之间的水流。在汇合处，宽阔的阿尔丹河继续流向勒拿河，将此地与北方巨大的水系相连。漫长冬季使河流封冻，直至春天冰雪消融。

english: Buluranriding is a river on the low eastern coast of Sumatra, flowing into the Bangka Strait east of the Musi estuary. Its mouth lies near Tanjung Selokan, along a shore backed by trees and intersected by smaller streams. Shallow banks of sand and mud extend into the strait along this coast, where the waters facing Bangka meet the drainage of the Sumatran lowlands. Rivers provide the natural openings through the wet coastal country.
simp_chinese: 布卢兰丁河位于苏门答腊低平的东海岸，在穆西河口以东注入邦加海峡。河口接近塞洛坎角，这段海岸后方林木覆盖，并有多条小河入海。浅水沙泥滩从岸边伸入海峡，在这里，面向邦加岛的水域与苏门答腊低地的排水相遇。河流成为进入湿润海岸地带的天然通道。

english: Bumbe lies in the southern country of the kingdom of Kongo, between the capital and the lands contested with Portuguese Angola. In 1622 a Portuguese force and its Jaga allies defeated an army raised from Kongo's provinces here. The battle was part of a wider struggle over the kingdom's southern territories and the routes toward Luanda. Kongo mobilized further forces, and the war did not end with the victory at Bumbe.
simp_chinese: 本贝位于刚果王国南部，处在都城与葡属安哥拉争夺的地区之间。1622年，一支葡萄牙军队及其贾加盟友在此击败由刚果各省征集的军队。这场战斗是争夺王国南部领土和通往罗安达道路的一部分。刚果随后动员更多兵力，本贝的胜利并未使战争结束。

sources.title: Vol 5. Africa from the Sixteenth to the Eighteenth Century editor B.A.OGOT(FILEminimizer).pdf

english: Bumbuli lies in the forested country of the central Congo basin, near the waterways of the Lukenie and Kasai system. Villages here stand among dense woodland and rivers that carry water westwards towards the Congo. The forest provides materials and food alongside cultivated clearings, while boats and paths connect communities across a landscape where rivers are among the most prominent features.
simp_chinese: 本布利位于刚果盆地中部林地，靠近卢凯尼与开赛水系。村落坐落在茂密森林和向西流入刚果河的河流之间。森林与耕作空地共同提供食物和材料，船只及小路则将各社群连接起来；河流是这里景观中最显著的特征之一。

english:
Bumbuzi belongs to the Shangani country of Zimbabwe. The Shangani River begins near Gweru, with the Gweru River among its main tributaries, and crosses the Midlands and Matabeleland North before emptying into the Gwayi. Its basin therefore links central plateaus with the drier west through a single northward drainage route.

The country is a wooded plateau of mopane and miombo woodland, with sandy soils, seasonal streams and pools that hold water through the dry months. Its people were Kalanga, Nambya and Tonga communities, who grew sorghum and millet, kept cattle and goats, and hunted elephants whose ivory was carried by traders toward the Zambezi and the Indian Ocean coast. This western part of the plateau lay within the sphere of the Torwa state, whose stone-walled capital at Khami flourished in the fifteenth to seventeenth centuries, and later of the Rozvi rulers. For settlements near the river, its reliable drainage and route through the plateau country made the banks a natural corridor.
simp_chinese:
本布兹属于津巴布韦的尚加尼地区。尚加尼河发源于圭鲁附近，圭鲁河是其主要支流之一，河流穿过中部省与北马塔贝莱兰，最后注入瓜伊河。因此，流域以一条向北排水的水道，把中部高原与较干燥的西部连接起来。

这里是长着莫帕尼和米翁博林地的林地高原，土壤沙质，有季节性溪流和旱季里仍留存水的水潭。居民是卡兰加、南比亚和汤加社群，他们种植高粱和小米，饲养牛羊，并猎捕大象，象牙由商人运往赞比西河和印度洋沿岸。高原西部属于托尔瓦国的势力范围，其石墙都城卡米在十五至十七世纪兴盛，后来又归于罗兹维统治者。对河岸附近的聚落而言，稳定的排水系统及穿越高原的河谷，构成自然通道。

english:
Bumiayu stands beside the Lematang River, between Palembang and the Pasemah highlands of southern Sumatra. Its brick temples and sculptures mark a Hindu religious centre in a region often associated with the Buddhist kingdom of Srivijaya. The shrine closest to the river was dedicated to Shiva; carved figures and terracotta decoration testify to a rich artistic life on this inland waterway.

The complex developed from around the ninth century and saw further construction in the thirteenth. Sculptures from the later phase bear fierce faces and skull ornaments associated with Tantric imagery. Chinese ceramics found at the site reveal connections beyond the Lematang valley, while the river itself offered a route between the highlands and Palembang. Bumiayu shows the variety of beliefs and artistic traditions that flourished in the interior of the Srivijayan world.
simp_chinese:
布米阿尤位于苏门答腊南部勒马唐河畔，处在巨港与帕塞马高地之间。砖造寺庙和雕像标志着一个印度教宗教中心；这片地区通常与佛教王国室利佛逝联系在一起。最靠近河流的神殿供奉湿婆，雕像和陶塑装饰展现了内陆水道上的丰富艺术生活。

寺庙群约从九世纪开始发展，十三世纪又有新的建筑。较晚期的雕像带有凶猛面容和骷髅装饰，与密教图像有关。遗址出土的中国瓷器显示了勒马唐河谷之外的联系，而河流本身提供了连接高地与巨港的路线。布米阿尤展现出室利佛逝世界内陆繁盛的多样信仰和艺术传统。

sources.title: no. 22 ceramics from the musi river palembangsmall.pdf

english:
Bumthang comprises a cluster of high valleys in central Bhutan, where glacial streams water wheat, buckwheat and pasture beneath forested mountains. Its name means “beautiful field,” and the broad valley floor made it a major center of settlement and agriculture in a country dominated by steep ridges.

Jambay Lhakhang was founded in the seventh century, and Kurjey is associated with Padmasambhava. During the period covered here, Bumthang became a leading center of Tibetan Buddhism: Longchen Rabjam founded Shingkhar Dechenling around 1350, and local monasteries accumulated land, tenants and religious authority. Bumthang was also one of several small kingdoms before Bhutan’s unification.

Ngawang Namgyal, the Zhabdrung, brought Bumthang under his rule in the seventeenth century. Jakar became the seat of a fortress and provincial administration; the first Trongsa Penlop subdued local lords and extended control over the central valleys. Monasteries, landed estates and the dzong system tied farmers and herders to a wider Buddhist state while preserving Bumthang’s place as a sacred valley and a route between central and eastern Bhutan.
simp_chinese:
布姆唐由不丹中部的多座高谷组成，冰川溪流在森林山地之间灌溉小麦、荞麦和牧场。“布姆唐”意为美丽田野，较宽阔的谷底使它成为陡峭山国中便于聚落和农业发展的核心之一。

江白寺始建于七世纪，库杰寺则与莲花生传说相连。在这一时期，布姆唐成为藏传佛教的重要中心：隆钦饶绛巴约于1350年创建辛喀德庆林，地方寺院逐渐积累土地、属民和宗教权威。不丹尚未统一以前，布姆唐也是若干小王国之一。

十七世纪，夏仲阿旺南杰把布姆唐纳入统治。贾卡尔建立宗堡和省级行政机构，首任通萨本洛制服地方领主，把控制扩展到中部诸谷。寺院、庄园和宗堡制度把农牧民联系到更大的佛教国家，也使布姆唐继续兼具圣谷以及中、东不丹交通要地的身份。

english: The waters off Bunbury border the southwestern Australian coast and the country of the Wardandi people. The shore includes the mouth of the Collie River and the sheltered waters of Geographe Bay farther south. Noongar people had long maintained ties to this coast when British settlers established Augusta in 1830.
simp_chinese: 班伯里外海毗邻澳大利亚西南海岸与瓦丹迪人的土地。沿岸包括科利河口，南方还有较受庇护的地理学家湾。1830年英国移民建立奥古斯塔时，努恩加人与这段海岸的联系已延续很久。

english:
Bunce Island lies in the Sierra Leone estuary, where ships from the Atlantic could meet traders coming downriver. Its small size belies the reach of the commerce once conducted there: a fortified trading station on the island became a centre of the transatlantic slave trade. Local African and Afro-European merchants supplied captives to its European operators, linking inland networks to ships bound across the ocean.

An English trading post was established here in the late seventeenth century. After an attack in 1728, the fort was rebuilt, and later in the eighteenth century London merchants made Bunce Island a major supplier of enslaved Africans to plantations in South Carolina and Georgia. Many of those transported were taken from rice-growing regions of West Africa. The fort and its yards bear witness to a trade that tore people from their homes and carried them across the Atlantic.
simp_chinese:
邦斯岛位于塞拉利昂河口，大西洋船只与沿河而来的商人在此相遇。岛屿虽小，却曾是大西洋奴隶贸易的重要据点。当地非洲及非欧混血商人向欧洲经营者提供被俘者，将内陆贸易网络与远航船只连接起来。

英国商人在十七世纪末于岛上设立贸易站。1728年遭袭后，堡垒得到重建；十八世纪后期，伦敦商人以此为据点，向南卡罗来纳和佐治亚的种植园运送大量被奴役的非洲人。其中许多人来自西非的稻作地区。堡垒及其围场见证了这场使人们离开家园、被迫横渡大西洋的贸易。

english:
Bundi lies in a narrow valley below the Taragarh fort, surrounded by hills in southeastern Rajasthan. The Hada Chauhan rulers made it the centre of their state, building palaces and reservoirs against the steep slopes. The town is also known for a distinctive school of painting, whose artists filled manuscripts and palace walls with vivid scenes of courtly life, hunting and the seasons.

The Hadas established their rule at Bundi in the fourteenth century. In 1569 their ruler Surjan surrendered Ranthambore to the Mughal emperor Akbar and entered imperial service. The Bundi court maintained its own artistic traditions while participating in the wider Mughal world. A Ragamala series dated 1591 belongs to the early development of its painting school, and later rulers sponsored further murals and miniatures. Fort, palace and paintings together reflect the ambitions of a Rajput court that combined military authority with patronage of the arts.
simp_chinese:
本迪位于拉贾斯坦东南部狭窄山谷，塔拉加尔堡俯瞰城镇，四周群山环绕。哈达乔汉统治者以此为邦国中心，在陡坡上修建宫殿与蓄水池。城镇还以独特绘画流派闻名，画家在手稿与宫墙上描绘宫廷生活、狩猎和四季的生动画面。

哈达人于十四世纪在本迪建立统治。1569年，其统治者苏尔詹向莫卧儿皇帝阿克巴交出伦滕波尔，并进入帝国服务。本迪宫廷参与更广泛的莫卧儿世界，同时保持自己的艺术传统。一组1591年的《拉格玛拉》画作属于其画派早期发展阶段，后世统治者继续赞助壁画和细密画。堡垒、宫殿与绘画共同反映了拉杰普特宫廷将军事权威与艺术赞助结合的抱负。

english: Bundjalung country stretches across the rivers, forests and coast of northeastern New South Wales and into southeastern Queensland. It includes many communities and language varieties connected by kinship and shared traditions. The Richmond and Clarence river systems flow through the broader region toward the Pacific Ocean.
simp_chinese: 邦贾朗人的土地横跨新南威尔士东北部的河流、森林与海岸，并延伸至昆士兰东南部。其间有许多通过亲属关系和共同传统联系起来的社群与语言变体。里士满河和克拉伦斯河水系流经这一广大地区，注入太平洋。

english: Bungabali was a kingdom of the Alor and Pantar island world, east of Flores. Oral traditions remember the arrival of ancestors from across the sea and the establishment of a ruling house at Alor Besar. Bungabali belonged to an alliance known as Galiyao Watan Lema, or the five coastal lands, with neighbours including Kui, Pandai and Baranusa. Stories of these alliances recall connections reaching westward to Solor as well as between the islands around Alor.
simp_chinese: 邦加巴厘是弗洛勒斯以东阿罗尔与潘塔尔群岛世界中的一个王国。口述传统记得祖先从海上到来，并在大阿罗尔建立统治家族。邦加巴厘属于“加利亚奥瓦丹勒马”，即五个沿海之地组成的联盟，邻邦包括库伊、潘代和巴拉努萨。这些联盟的故事记载了阿罗尔周边岛屿之间的联系，也将联系向西延伸至索洛尔。

english: The Bunga Laut Strait separates Siberut from Sipora in the Mentawai Islands west of Sumatra. Small islands, including Masokut, stand in the passage between the larger shores. The Mentawai chain forms a non-volcanic arc in the Indian Ocean, divided from the Sumatran mainland by the waters of the Mentawai Strait.
simp_chinese: 邦加劳特海峡分隔苏门答腊以西明打威群岛中的西伯路岛与西波拉岛。马索库特等小岛坐落在两座大岛之间的水道中。明打威群岛在印度洋上形成一条非火山岛弧，明打威海峡将其与苏门答腊大陆分开。

english: Bungi lies in the Pinrang country of southern Sulawesi, near the lands of several small kingdoms. Local accounts remember it as a meeting place for the rulers of Batulappa, Lampa and Rajang, with a great house associated with their dealings. Its market drew visitors from the surrounding area, and Bungi became linked to the kingdom of Batulappa. In the local Pattinjo language, its name is traditionally connected with a word for spending the night.
simp_chinese: 邦吉位于苏拉威西南部的平朗地区，邻近几个小王国的土地。地方记载称，这里是巴图拉帕、兰帕和拉让统治者会面的地方，设有与他们往来有关的大屋。邦吉的市场吸引周边居民前来，后来此地与巴图拉帕王国相连。当地帕廷佐语中，其名称相传与“过夜”一词有关。

english:
Bungku lies in the Morowali country of Central Sulawesi, among hills and tropical forest that link interior communities with the province’s coastal districts. Seasonal rain shapes movement and cultivation: rainfall is more moderate from September to November, then becomes heavy from December through August. The surrounding terrain and dense vegetation support streams, local travel routes and scattered settlement, while the small coastal and lowland approaches provide openings toward the surrounding seas.

From at least the sixteenth century Bungku was associated with a kingdom tied to Ternate. Its rulers collected tribute and controlled trade in sago, fish, resin and rattan, while village nobles retained land and forest rights. Mountain trails joined interior gardens with sheltered anchorages on the Gulf of Tolo.

Bungku became an important political and market centre in the narrow lowland between hills and sea. Its position allowed it to control routes from the interior and small vessels using the gulf. Dutch treaties and expeditions later entered the kingdom, but older clan authorities and exchange networks remained central to local life.
simp_chinese:
朋古位于中苏拉威西的莫罗瓦利地区，周围是丘陵与热带森林，连接内陆社区和省内沿海地区。降水具有明显季节差异：九月至十一月较为缓和，十二月至次年八月则雨量丰沛。起伏地形和茂密植被涵养溪流，也影响道路、聚落和日常往来；较靠近海岸与低地的方向，则为通向周围海域提供出口。

自十六世纪起，朋古与一个同特尔纳特联系的王国相关。统治者征收贡赋，控制西米、鱼类、树脂和藤条贸易，村庄贵族仍掌握土地与森林权利。山地小径把内陆园圃同托洛湾避风锚地相连。

朋古在丘陵与海洋之间的狭长低地发展为政治和市场中心，控制通往内陆的道路和海湾小船。荷兰条约与远征后来进入王国，较早的氏族权威和交换网络仍是地方生活核心。

english: Bungu lies east of Lake Rukwa, in a basin enclosed by the Ufipa escarpment and the Mbeya Range. The lake has no outlet to the sea, and its shallow waters expand and retreat as the rivers feeding it change. From the south come the Songwe, Lupa and Chambua; the Rungwa enters from the north, while the Momba approaches from the west. Their floodplains and seasonal streams make the shores of Rukwa a shifting landscape.
simp_chinese: 本古位于鲁夸湖以东，湖盆被乌菲帕断崖和姆贝亚山脉围绕。鲁夸湖没有通海出口，浅湖水面随入湖河流的水量涨落。松圭河、卢帕河与昌布阿河从南方流来，伦瓜河来自北方，蒙巴河则从西方汇入。洪泛平原与季节性河流使鲁夸湖岸不断变化。

english: Bungu, also called Vungu, was a kingdom in the wooded hills of Mayombe, on the north bank of the Congo River. Traditions kept at the Kongo court, written down by the Jesuit Mateus Cardoso in 1624, placed the first king of Kongo here before he crossed the river to conquer the lands to the south. King Afonso I named Bungu among his possessions in a letter of 1535. By the 1620s the Jaga, driven out of Kongo, had moved north, allied themselves with Loango and occupied Bungu, a neighbour of the coastal kingdoms of Ngoyo and Kakongo.
simp_chinese: 本古又称文古，是刚果河北岸马永贝林地丘陵中的一个王国。刚果王廷保存的传说由耶稣会士马特乌斯·卡尔多佐于1624年记录下来，称刚果的第一位国王曾在这里统治，后来渡河征服南方的土地。1535年，国王阿方索一世在一封信中把本古列入自己的领地。到17世纪20年代，被逐出刚果的雅加人北上，与洛安戈结盟并占据了本古，这里邻近沿海的恩戈约和卡孔戈两个王国。

english:
Bunji occupies a sharp meeting of routes at the confluence of the Astore River and the Indus. It lies in the Astore valley, about 50 kilometres from Gilgit. To the east and south rise mountain walls, while the valley floor offers the narrow accessible land around the two rivers. This setting made Bunji a natural point for travellers moving between the Astore Valley, the Indus corridor and the passes toward Gilgit.

Its clear air and mountain-defined fields also reflect the cool, arid climate of an inner Himalayan valley. The settlement was formerly called Bawanji. The Astore Valley came under control of Skardu during the rule of Ali Sher Khan Anchan, and Bunji later became an economic centre for barter between Yaghistan and the Dogras.
simp_chinese:
本吉位于阿斯特河与印度河交汇处，河谷在这里收束，形成几条山路相接的节点。它位于阿斯特谷地，距吉尔吉特约50公里。东面和南面耸立山壁，谷底只有河流两侧的狭窄土地便于通行和耕作。这样的位置使本吉成为往来阿斯特谷、印度河通道与吉尔吉特方向山口之间的必经之处。

清澈空气和由山势划定的农田，也体现了喜马拉雅内谷凉爽干燥的气候。这里旧称巴万吉。阿里·谢尔·汗·安昌统治时期，阿斯特谷归斯卡尔杜控制；后来本吉成为亚吉斯坦与多格拉之间进行物物交换的经济中心。

english: Buñol lies west of Valencia beneath a castle that became the seat of the Mercader family. The lordship was raised to a county under Philip III, but the expulsion of the Moriscos in 1609 struck the district severely. Many inhabitants were forced to leave, and the resulting loss of population affected fields and settlements throughout the Hoya de Buñol. A new settlement charter issued in 1611 sought to bring people back under the authority of the count.
simp_chinese: 布尼奥尔位于瓦伦西亚以西，城堡曾是梅尔卡德家族的驻地。费利佩三世统治时期，此领地升为伯爵领，但1609年驱逐摩里斯科人的命令给这一地区带来沉重打击。许多居民被迫离开，人口流失影响了整个布尼奥尔盆地的田野和聚落。1611年颁发的新定居特许状试图在伯爵权威之下重新招募居民。

english:
Bunratty Castle stands beside the River Ratty near its entry into the Shannon estuary, guarding an important approach to Limerick. Its tall stone towers incorporate remains of earlier fortifications built by Anglo-Norman lords. The MacNamaras held the castle before it passed to the O'Briens of Thomond in the early sixteenth century, becoming a seat of the earls.

During the wars of the 1640s, Barnaby O'Brien allowed English Parliamentarian forces to occupy Bunratty in 1646. Irish Confederate troops besieged the garrison, whose position on the estuary could be supplied by ships arriving from the sea. After months of fighting the defenders surrendered in July, and the Confederates took possession. The castle's command of the Shannon had made it a prize for both sides.
simp_chinese:
班拉蒂城堡矗立在拉蒂河畔，靠近河水注入香农河口之处，扼守通往利默里克的重要道路。高耸石塔中保存着盎格鲁—诺曼领主早期防御工事的遗迹。麦克纳马拉家族曾持有城堡，十六世纪初它转入托蒙德的奥布赖恩家族，成为伯爵的驻所。

1640年代战争中，巴纳比·奥布赖恩于1646年允许英格兰议会派军队进驻班拉蒂。爱尔兰联盟军随后围攻驻军，后者凭借河口位置可由海上船只运来补给。数月战斗后，守军于七月投降，联盟军占领城堡。对香农河的控制使这座堡垒成为双方争夺的目标。

english:
Bunuba country covers the southern West Kimberley: limestone ranges cut by the Fitzroy and its tributaries, deep gorges such as Geikie and Windjana, and broken high country extending toward the Oscar Range. Waterholes in the gorges and along the rivers made these seemingly harsh lands habitable, supporting movement between exposed ridges and sheltered valleys.

The Bunuba are one of the traditional owners of this country, and Bunuba is one of only two languages in the Bunuban family. For centuries, families moved with the wet and dry seasons, harvesting fish, shellfish, game and plant foods from river pools, grasslands and rocky uplands. Oral law connected particular lineages to named gorges, springs and ranges; marriage and exchange linked them to neighboring Ngarinyin and Gooniyandi communities.

The river and its permanent pools formed the densest concentrations of food and the principal corridors through the limestone. The ranges shaped movement and boundaries without enclosing the population in a few permanent towns. Bunuba country remained a network of water, shelter and ceremonial places, with European ships and coastal visitors affecting the far north Kimberley more than these inland gorges.
simp_chinese:
布努巴人的故土覆盖西金伯利南部：菲茨罗伊河及其支流切穿石灰岩山脉，形成盖基峡谷、温贾纳峡谷等深谷，破碎高地则伸向奥斯卡山脉。峡谷和河边的水潭使这片看似严酷的土地可以长期居住，也决定了人们在裸露山脊与遮蔽谷地之间的移动。

布努巴人是这里的传统所有者之一，其语言是布努班语系仅有的两种语言之一。数个世纪中，家庭随雨季和旱季迁移，在河潭、草地和岩质高地采集鱼类、贝类、猎物与植物。口传法把特定宗族同具名的峡谷、泉眼和山脉联系起来，婚姻和交换又使他们与邻近的恩加林因、古尼亚恩迪社群相连。

山脉塑造道路和边界，却没有把人口集中到少数永久的城镇。布努巴地域始终由水源、庇护处和仪式地点组成，欧洲船只与沿岸来客对金伯利北部的影响，远大于这些内陆峡谷。

english:
Bunut belongs to the upper Kapuas world in the interior of Borneo, within the region at that time called Kapuas Hulu Regency. The district occupies the upper drainage of the Kapuas River and reaches the border with Sarawak. Much of this land is sparsely populated and covered by forest, with numerous lakes, swamps and wetlands. River levels can submerge the lower ground for as long as six months, while many communities sit close to waterways that historically supplied the most practical means of movement and exchange.

Danau Sentarum’s connected lakes and peat swamps lie west of Putussibau, and their seasonal drawdown reveals shifting channels, fishing grounds and cultivated ground. Political authority followed those river routes but remained fragmented. Selimbau held influence from the Sultanate of Sambas during the early seventeenth and eighteenth centuries, while several smaller Malay kingdoms and chieftaincies, including Suhai, Jongkong and Bunut, were scattered through the region. Dutch explorers entered in 1823, and the colonial government made a treaty recognising Selimbau’s domination over the smaller polities.

Bunut’s history therefore records a small riverine domain absorbed into wider networks of Malay rulers, forest products and colonial administration.
simp_chinese:
布努特属于婆罗洲内陆的上卡普阿斯世界，位于此后的卡普阿斯胡卢县。这里占据卡普阿斯河上游流域，并一直延伸到与马来西亚砂拉越交界的地区。土地人口稀少，大片区域覆盖森林，还有众多湖泊、沼泽和湿地。河水上涨时，低地可能被淹没长达六个月；许多聚落依水而建，因为水路长期是最实际的交通和交换通道。

普图西包以西的森塔鲁姆湖由相连湖泊和泥炭沼泽组成，季节性退水会显露变化的水道、渔场和耕地。政治权力沿河网分布，却始终分散。十七至十八世纪初，塞林包在 Sambas 苏丹国影响下控制当地，苏海、宗孔和布努特等较小的马来王国与酋长领则散布其间。1823年荷兰人开始探查这一地区，殖民政府随后与塞林包签约，承认它对较小政权的支配。

布努特的历史因此是一处小河流域领地的经历：它依托水路与森林物产，后来被纳入马来统治者网络和殖民行政体系。

english: Buor-Ürex, whose Sakha name means “clay stream,” rises near the Kyundyulyun mountains and flows northeast to join the Chondon from the left. The Chondon crosses the Yana–Indigirka lowland on its way to the Laptev Sea. The tributary descends from higher ground into the broad Arctic plain, where rivers wind among lakes and marshes and winter ice persists for many months.
simp_chinese: 博尔尤里亚赫的萨哈语名称意为“黏土溪流”。它发源于昆久留恩山区附近，向东北流，从左岸汇入琼东河。琼东河穿越亚纳—因迪吉尔卡低地，流向拉普捷夫海。支流从高地降入广阔北极平原，河流在湖泊和沼泽间蜿蜒，冬季冰封持续数月。

english:
The Buotama begins in the northern Aldan Highlands and runs northeast through a narrow valley beside the Lena Plateau before bending north to enter the Lena about one hundred kilometres above Yakutsk. Its 418-kilometre course crosses larch forest, frozen ground and a dense network of small drainage lines. More than sixty tributaries and roughly two hundred lakes store water across the basin.

Snowmelt and summer rain produce the main flood in May. The river freezes between October and November and opens at the end of April or early May, so ice governs travel for much of the year. Evenki hunting and fishing communities used the valleys and lakes through seasonal camps, following game and fish while moving by boat, ski and reindeer. River crossings and winter tracks joined the Aldan uplands to the Lena corridor.

The broad valley offered pasture, timber and shelter in a severe climate. Families moved between hunting grounds, fishing places and river settlements, using local knowledge of flood timing and ice thickness. The Buotama therefore belonged to a Sakha and Evenki landscape of water routes, seasonal camps and long-distance movement before industrial settlement altered parts of the basin.
simp_chinese:
布奥塔马河发源于阿尔丹高地北部，向东北穿过勒拿高原旁的狭窄谷地，随后折向北，在雅库茨克上游约一百公里处汇入勒拿河。河道全长四百一十八公里，穿越落叶松林、冻土和密集的小支流网络。流域内六十多条支流和约两百个湖泊共同蓄积水源。

融雪与夏季降雨在五月形成主要洪水。河流于十月至十一月封冻，次年四月底或五月初开河，冰情因而在一年大部分时间决定通行。埃文基人的狩猎与捕鱼社群利用谷地和湖泊设置季节营地，追随兽群与鱼汛，以船只、滑雪板和驯鹿移动。渡口与冬季道路把阿尔丹高地同勒拿河走廊相连。

宽广河谷在严酷气候中提供牧场、木材与庇护。家庭在猎场、渔点和河畔聚落之间迁移，依靠关于洪水和冰厚的知识。工业聚落改变部分流域以前，布奥塔马属于萨哈人与埃文基人的水路、季节营地和长途迁徙景观。

english: Bur lies on the Nepa River in the forested interior of Siberia. The Nepa is a tributary of the Lower Tunguska, carrying water onward to the Yenisei. Rivers and their tributaries wind through the taiga, where a long winter freeze gives way to a brief season of open water and travel along the valleys.
simp_chinese: 布尔位于西伯利亚森林内陆的涅帕河畔。涅帕河是下通古斯卡河的支流，河水继续流向叶尼塞河。河流与支流在泰加林中蜿蜒，漫长冬季冰封后，水道迎来短暂的无冰期，人们得以沿河谷往来。

english:
Bura belongs to the wider Liptako region of the central Sahel, a country of grasslands and seasonal watercourses extending towards the Niger. Pastoralists, farmers and traders moved through a region inhabited by Fula, Gourmantche, Mossi and Songhai communities.

In the early nineteenth century, Braahima Seydu established the Fulani emirate of Liptako around Dori after a struggle with the Gourmantche. The emirate was part of a wider network of Islamic states in the western Sahel.
simp_chinese:
布拉属于中部萨赫勒的利普塔科广大地区，这片草原与季节性河道组成的土地向尼日尔河方向延伸。牧民、农民和商人往来其间，地区居民包括富拉尼人、古尔芒切人、莫西人和桑海人。

19世纪初，布拉希马·赛杜在与古尔芒切人的斗争之后，建立了以多里为中心的富拉尼利普塔科酋长国。这个酋长国属于西萨赫勒更广阔的伊斯兰国家网络。

english:
Burao lies on the elevated interior behind the Somali coast, where the dry Togdheer valley runs through open land with relatively rich soil. The name describes that raised, fertile country. Water along the valley made the area important to nomads and herds, and the town originated around the well of Ceel-Gooni in the late eighteenth century. As settlement gathered around the well, Burao became a small inland market that connected the port of Berbera with the grazing lands of the interior. Livestock and provisions moved along this route, joining coastal commerce to the seasonal needs of pastoral communities.

During much of the nineteenth century Burao served as the capital of the Habr Yunis Sultanate. Sultan Nur Ahmed Aman, Sultan Awad Deria and Sultan Madar Hersi ruled there at different times. Its growth depended on livestock markets and the routes linking the interior with Berbera.
simp_chinese:
布劳位于索马里海岸后方的高原内陆，干燥的托格代尔河谷穿过土壤较肥沃的开阔地带。地名所描述的正是这种高起而富饶的土地。谷地中的水源对牧民和牲畜十分重要，城镇于十八世纪后期围绕 Ceel-Gooni 水井形成。随着居民在水井周围聚集，布劳成为连接柏培拉港与内陆牧场的集市。牲畜和物资沿这一路线移动，把沿海贸易同游牧社区的季节性需求连接起来。

十九世纪的大部分时间，布劳是哈布尔尤尼斯苏丹国的都城。努尔·艾哈迈德·阿曼、阿瓦德·德里亚和马达尔·赫尔西等苏丹曾先后在此统治。牲畜市场和连接内地与柏培拉的路线继续推动它发展。

english: The Blyth and Cadell rivers spread over broad floodplains before reaching the Arafura Sea in central Arnhem Land. On both sides of the Blyth, Burarra clan groups have passed down the making of an-gujechiya, fish traps woven from jungle vines or sedge grass. Set in creeks between fences, the conical traps catch fish including barramundi in fresh and salt water.
simp_chinese: 布莱斯河与卡德尔河流经广阔的洪泛平原，最终在阿纳姆地中部注入阿拉弗拉海。布莱斯河两岸的布拉拉各氏族世代传承着编制安古杰奇亚鱼笼的技艺：人们用丛林藤蔓或莎草编成圆锥形鱼笼，再将其置于溪流中的围栏之间，捕捉出没于淡水和咸水的澳洲尖吻鲈等鱼类。

english:
Buraydah is an oasis town in the heart of Qasim, in the valley country of central Arabia. Wells and palm groves sustained its inhabitants amid the dry Najd plateau. Its position placed it among routes leading from the interior toward the Hijaz and the markets of Iraq. The town grew around a watering place acquired by the Abu Ulayyan family, who came from Tharmada in al-Washm during the sixteenth century.

The Abu Ulayyan became the ruling family of Buraydah, and the town grew into a centre of authority over much of Qasim. In the later eighteenth century the expansion of the state based at Diriyah brought it into wider struggles. Under Hujaylan ibn Hamad, Buraydah was fortified and remained loyal to the Saudi cause when other Qasim settlements rebelled. Saadun ibn Urayir besieged it for months, but failed to take the town. Its walls and defenders made Buraydah a stronghold of Saudi influence in the region. Following the siege, other Qasim communities sought terms with Hujaylan, who granted them protection.

The fall of Diriyah to Ibrahim Pasha in 1818 was followed by upheaval in Qasim. Rivalry among local rulers and successive Ottoman-Egyptian expeditions brought violence, heavy demands and insecurity. Buraydah's fortunes remained bound to the changing balance of power across Najd.
simp_chinese:
布赖代是阿拉伯中部卡西姆腹地的一座绿洲城镇。水井和枣椰园在干旱的内志高原上养育居民；它所在的道路又把内陆与汉志及伊拉克市场联系起来。十六世纪，来自瓦什姆地区萨尔马达的阿布乌莱扬家族购得当地水源地，城镇围绕它逐渐成长。

阿布乌莱扬成为布赖代的统治家族，这座城镇也发展为掌管卡西姆大部分地区的中心。十八世纪后期，以德拉伊耶为基地的国家向外扩张，将它卷入更广泛的争斗。在胡贾伊兰·伊本·哈马德统治下，布赖代修筑防御设施；卡西姆其他聚落反叛时，它仍支持沙特势力。萨敦·伊本·欧赖尔围城数月，却未能攻克。城墙与守军使布赖代成为沙特在这一地区的据点。围城结束后，卡西姆其他地方向胡贾伊兰求和，他给予了他们保护。

1818年德拉伊耶被易卜拉欣帕夏攻陷后，卡西姆陷入动荡。地方统治者之间的争夺和接连到来的奥斯曼—埃及远征军带来暴力、沉重征敛与不安全。布赖代的命运仍与内志各方势力的消长紧密相连。

english: Burayevo was founded in 1610 by Bashkirs of the Yeldyak district on their own hereditary land. Its name is associated with the Bashkir landholder Buray Yergozin. The village grew in the country between the Belaya and Kama, and in 1795 its population was recorded as 713. Its inhabitants cultivated grain, raised livestock and kept bees, combining farming with the resources of the surrounding woods and meadows.
simp_chinese: 布拉耶沃由叶尔佳克辖区的巴什基尔人于1610年在自己的世袭土地上建立，村名与巴什基尔土地持有者布赖·叶尔戈津有关。村庄在别拉亚河与卡马河之间的地区发展，1795年记录有713名居民。他们种植谷物、饲养牲畜、养蜂，将耕作与周围林地和草甸的资源结合起来。

english: Burchmullo lies among the western Tian Shan valleys near the confluence of the Chatkal and Koksu rivers. Routes descending from both valleys meet here before continuing toward the Tashkent oasis. Archaeological finds include houses, workshops and a market area, with occupation reaching back to the early medieval period. Some scholars associate the settlement with Ardanket, a town named in tenth-century sources. Its mountain setting linked the inhabitants of the upper valleys with the towns of Chach below.
simp_chinese: 布尔奇穆洛位于西天山河谷中，靠近恰特卡尔河与科克苏河的汇合处。从两条山谷下来的道路在此交会，再通向塔什干绿洲。考古发现包括民居、作坊和市场遗迹，居住历史可追溯至中世纪早期。一些学者将此地与十世纪文献提到的阿尔丹凯特城联系起来。山间位置使上游河谷居民与下方赭石城镇相连。

english: The Burdekin rises on the northern slopes of Boulder Mountain in the Valley of Lagoons, on the western side of the Seaview Range, and flows south-east through the dry tropical uplands of north Queensland towards the Coral Sea, more than 200 kilometres away. In flood it carries more water than any other river in Australia. Its upper course, around the Valley of Lagoons, lies in the language country of the Gugu Badhun.
simp_chinese: 伯德金河发源于海景山脉西侧、潟湖谷的博尔德山北坡，向东南穿过昆士兰北部干燥的热带高地，流入两百多公里外的珊瑚海。洪水期间，它的流量居澳大利亚诸河之首。潟湖谷一带的上游，属于古古巴顿人的语言地域。

english: The Burdekin River reaches the Coral Sea on the north Queensland coast, spreading through a broad delta and estuary. Its waters carry sediment from a large inland catchment toward the Great Barrier Reef lagoon. Aboriginal peoples including the Bindal and Yuru have longstanding connections to the lower river and adjacent coast.
simp_chinese: 伯德金河在昆士兰北部海岸注入珊瑚海，形成宽广的三角洲和河口。河水从广大内陆集水区携带泥沙，流向大堡礁内侧海域。包括宾达尔人与尤鲁人在内的原住民族与河流下游及邻近海岸有着长久联系。

english:
Burdur lies in the lake country of southwestern Anatolia, in a basin surrounded by the western Taurus. The town grew around a great mosque founded in 1300 by Dündar Bey, ruler of the Hamidid principality. Its position among lakes and mountain roads made it a centre for nearby villages and the cultivated lands of the basin.

Bayezid I brought Burdur under Ottoman rule in 1391. In the following centuries the town formed part of the Hamid sancak and expanded as an important local market. Records show its market tax rising between 1522 and 1568, reflecting the growth of trade. The mosque remained a focus of the town, and its repair in 1749 illustrates the continued attention paid to the foundation established by the Hamidid ruler.
simp_chinese:
布尔杜尔位于安纳托利亚西南部湖区，坐落于西托罗斯山脉环绕的盆地。城镇围绕哈米德公国统治者敦达尔贝伊于1300年创建的大清真寺发展。湖泊和山路之间的位置使它成为附近村庄及盆地耕地的中心。

1391年，巴耶济德一世将布尔杜尔纳入奥斯曼统治。此后数百年，城镇属于哈米德桑贾克，并作为地方市场扩展。记录显示1522至1568年市场税收入增长，反映贸易发展。清真寺仍是城镇中心，1749年的修缮显示人们继续重视哈米德统治者设立的基金会。

english: Burebasaga is one of Fiji’s great chiefly confederations, centred on Rewa in the southeast of Viti Levu. The Rewa River and its delta connect the interior with the sea, and chiefly houses along this coast maintained relationships through marriage, alliance and rivalry. The title Roko Tui Dreketi belongs to the paramount chief of Burebasaga, whose authority was rooted in Rewa and its chiefly lineages.
simp_chinese: 布雷巴萨加是斐济重要的酋长联盟之一，以维提岛东南部的雷瓦为中心。雷瓦河及其三角洲连接内陆与海洋，这片海岸的酋长家族通过通婚、结盟与竞争维系关系。罗科图伊恩德雷凯蒂是布雷巴萨加最高酋长的头衔，其权威扎根于雷瓦及当地酋长世系。

english: The Bureen, called the Bryanka in Russian, is a tributary of the Uda in the country east of Lake Baikal. It rises in the Tsagan-Daban range and flows through wooded mountains, where its upper course is known as the Shabur. Farther downstream the valley widens and the river changes direction before joining the Uda. Archaeological sites in the valley attest to human occupation there many thousands of years ago.
simp_chinese: 布伦河在俄语中称为布良卡河，是贝加尔湖以东乌达河的一条支流。它发源于察甘达坂山脉，穿过林木覆盖的山地，上游称为沙布尔河。下游河谷逐渐开阔，河流转向后汇入乌达河。河谷中的考古遗址表明，早在数万年前已有居民在这里生活。

english:
Büren lies on the Paderborn Plateau, where the Afte flows into the Alme. Around 1150 the lords of Büren built a castle at the confluence, and in 1195 the Bishop of Paderborn agreed to the founding of a town beneath it: he shared the cost of the walls and granted rights of coinage and toll, and in return the lords held the town of him as a fief. Downstream on the Alme stands the Wewelsburg, rebuilt between 1603 and 1609 for the prince-bishops on a rare triangular plan.

The family died out in 1661 with Moritz von Büren, who left his lordship to the Jesuits. The old castles were pulled down between 1717 and 1728, and in the same years the Jesuits raised a broad Baroque college in the town. Their property passed to the Prussian state in 1802–03.
simp_chinese:
布伦位于帕德博恩高原，阿夫特河在此汇入阿尔默河。约1150年，布伦领主在两河交汇处筑起城堡；1195年，帕德博恩主教同意在城堡下建城，分担城墙费用，并授予铸币和征收关税之权，领主则把城镇作为主教的封地持有。阿尔默河下游的韦弗尔斯堡于1603至1609年为采邑主教重建，平面呈罕见的三角形。

1661年，最后一位领主莫里茨·冯·布伦去世，把领地留给耶稣会。1717至1728年，旧城堡陆续拆除，耶稣会同期在城中建起宽大的巴洛克式学院。1802至1803年，这些产业转归普鲁士。

english: Buren lies in the valley of the Kaa-Khem, or Little Yenisei, among the wooded hills of eastern Tuva. Burial grounds near Buren-Khem preserve evidence of inhabitants from several periods, including an early Scythian grave. The Kaa-Khem flows west through the mountain country to join the Great Yenisei, forming the river that continues north across Siberia.
simp_chinese: 布伦位于图瓦东部林木覆盖的丘陵之间，坐落在卡赫姆河，即小叶尼塞河的河谷。布伦赫姆附近的墓地保存了不同时期居民的遗迹，其中包括一座早期斯基泰墓葬。卡赫姆河向西流经山地，与大叶尼塞河汇合，形成继续向北穿越西伯利亚的大河。

english: The Bureya Mountains form a wooded watershed between the Bureya, Amgun and Urmi river systems. Coniferous and broadleaf forests cover their slopes, while mountain streams descend towards the great rivers of the Amur basin. The Suluk and Ayakit rise among these ranges and unite to form the Amgun, which flows northeast across a marshy valley before reaching the lower Amur. The mountains stand between this valley and the Bureya to the west.
simp_chinese: 布列亚山脉是布列亚河、恒滚河与乌尔米河水系之间的分水岭。山坡覆盖针叶林和阔叶林，山溪汇入黑龙江流域的大河。苏鲁克河和阿亚基特河发源于群山之间，汇合成恒滚河，向东北流过沼泽谷地，最终注入黑龙江下游。山脉隔开了恒滚河谷和西面的布列亚河。

english: Burg, east of Magdeburg, grew from an early Slavic settlement in the Jerichower Land. Mentioned in a charter of Otto I in 948, it became a town of the archbishops of Magdeburg and gained a reputation for cloth making. Churches, walls and towers marked a prosperous centre amid the lands contested by Magdeburg and Brandenburg. The Thirty Years' War brought plunder and plague to the region. The Peace of Prague assigned Burg to Electoral Saxony in 1635; in 1687 it was sold to Brandenburg-Prussia. Refugees from France and other lands settled here, bringing skills that contributed to local crafts. A road to Magdeburg, completed in 1820, improved the town's connections with its western neighbour.
simp_chinese: 布尔格位于马格德堡以东，由耶里肖地区的一处早期斯拉夫聚落发展而来。它见于奥托一世948年的宪章，后来成为马格德堡大主教的城镇，并以制呢手工业闻名。教堂、城墙和塔楼标志着这座繁荣的中心，周围土地则为马格德堡与勃兰登堡争夺。三十年战争给地区带来劫掠和瘟疫。1635年的布拉格和约将布尔格交给萨克森选侯；1687年，城镇被售予勃兰登堡-普鲁士。来自法国等地的难民在此定居，带来的技艺促进了当地手工业。1820年通向马格德堡的道路建成，改善了布尔格与西面邻城的联系。

english: Along the northern edge of the Hodna basin, mountain ridges link the Tell Atlas with the interior highlands. Among them rise the Maadid mountains, where steep slopes and ravines shelter the Qal'a of the Banu Hammad. Founded in 1007, this fortified capital of the Hammadids stood in a commanding position above the plain. Its palaces and great mosque recall the city that grew within the mountain walls before the dynasty moved its capital to Béjaïa.
simp_chinese: 霍德纳盆地北缘的山脊将泰勒阿特拉斯与内陆高地连接起来。其间的马阿迪德山坡陡谷深，庇护着巴努·哈马德城堡。这座哈马德王朝的设防都城建于1007年，占据俯瞰平原的险要位置。宫殿与大清真寺的遗迹，使人想起王朝迁都贝贾亚之前，在群山环绕中发展起来的城市。

english: North of the Hodna basin, the ridges of the Atlas rise between the Mediterranean-facing Tell and the dry interior. The Hodna mountains run eastward toward the Belezma and the Aurès, overlooking the enclosed basin below. Their northern slopes receive more rain and support cedar, oak and pine; farther south, the vegetation gives way to juniper and hardy grasses. Water descending from the mountains gathers in the low basin rather than reaching the sea.
simp_chinese: 霍德纳盆地以北，阿特拉斯山脊耸立在面向地中海的泰勒地区和干燥内陆之间。霍德纳山脉向东延伸至贝莱兹马和奥雷斯，俯瞰下方的封闭盆地。北坡雨水较多，生长着雪松、栎树和松树；往南则渐渐转为杜松与耐旱草丛。从山间流下的水汇入低洼盆地，并不通向大海。

english: Burga takes its name from the small river that runs past it through the forests east of the Volkhov. It is mentioned as a pogost in the sixteenth century, one of the church centres around which Novgorod’s rural districts were organised. Such a centre brought together a church, burial ground and the surrounding villages. The river and its wooded banks place Burga within the network of streams draining the country between the Volkhov and the Msta.
simp_chinese: 布尔加得名于流经村旁的小河，河水穿过沃尔霍夫河以东的森林。十六世纪文献将它记作教堂村，是诺夫哥罗德乡村辖区的教会中心之一。这样的中心将教堂、墓地和周围村落联系起来。河流与林岸使布尔加成为沃尔霍夫河和姆斯塔河之间溪流水网的一部分。

english:
Burgas stands at the western end of a broad Black Sea bay, among coastal lakes and wetlands. Its name is associated with an old tower, called pyrgos in Greek and burgus in Latin. The sea and the neighbouring lakes offered fishing grounds, while the sheltered bay gave the growing settlement a harbour for the trade of the surrounding country.

Under Ottoman rule Burgas belonged to the district of Aytos for much of its early history. Trade and grain exports helped the town grow in the seventeenth century, and its harbour also served ships carrying iron towards Constantinople. In 1786 the Austrian traveller Wenzel von Brognard described it as a market town of some eleven to twelve hundred houses. During the Russo-Ottoman War, Russian troops occupied Burgas in 1829; many Bulgarians left the region after the war.
simp_chinese:
布尔加斯位于黑海一处宽阔海湾的西端，周围是滨海湖泊和湿地。城名与一座古塔有关：希腊语称塔为皮尔戈斯，拉丁语称为布尔古斯。海洋与附近湖泊提供渔场，受庇护的海湾则为逐渐成长的聚落提供港口，便于周边地区贸易。

奥斯曼统治下，布尔加斯在早期相当长的时间里属于艾托斯辖区。十七世纪，贸易和粮食出口促进城镇发展，港口也供向君士坦丁堡运送铁的船只使用。1786年，奥地利旅行者文策尔·冯·布罗尼亚尔将它描述为一座约有一千一百至一千二百户的市镇。俄土战争期间，俄军于1829年占领布尔加斯；战后许多保加利亚人离开了这一地区。

english: Burgdorf lies east of Hanover and takes its name from a fortified seat recorded in the thirteenth century. After conflict involving the bishopric of Hildesheim, it came to the Welf dukes of Lüneburg. In 1433 Duke Otto rebuilt the castle and strengthened the settlement with a rampart, moats and three gates. These works gave Burgdorf the form of a small fortified town. Fires destroyed much of it in 1658 and again in 1809, but on each occasion its inhabitants rebuilt their homes.
simp_chinese: 布格多夫位于汉诺威以东，得名于一处十三世纪已有记载的设防驻地。在涉及希尔德斯海姆主教领的冲突之后，此地归属吕讷堡的韦尔夫公爵。1433年，奥托公爵重建城堡，并以土垣、壕沟和三座城门加强聚落防御，使布格多夫成为一座小型设防城镇。1658年和1809年的大火两次烧毁城镇大片地区，居民每次都重新建起家园。

english:
Burgdorf stands beside the Emme below a castle recorded in 1080. The dukes of Zähringen founded a town around the castle in the late twelfth century; their successors, the counts of Kyburg, enlarged it and made the castle their seat. By 1300 the growing town filled its walls, enclosing an upper town and a lower quarter formed from the settlement of Holzbrunnen.

In 1383 a Bernese and Solothurn army besieged Burgdorf for forty-five days during a war with the indebted Neu-Kyburg counts. The defenders held out, but in 1384 the counts sold Burgdorf and Thun to Bern. Burgdorf retained its own council and courts and gradually acquired lands and rights in neighbouring villages. Fires destroyed much of the upper town in 1706 and the lower town in 1715. The French invasion of 1798 and the reforms of the Helvetic Republic brought an end to much of its old privileged order.
simp_chinese:
布格多夫坐落在埃默河畔，城堡俯瞰着镇子，1080年的文献已提到这座城堡。策林根公爵于十二世纪末在城堡周围建立城镇；继任的基堡伯爵扩建了它，并以城堡为驻地。到1300年，扩展中的城市已填满城墙内的空间，包括上城和由霍尔茨布伦嫩聚落形成的下城。

1383年，伯尔尼和索洛图恩在与负债累累的新基堡伯爵家族交战时，派军围攻布格多夫四十五天。守军坚持了下来，但伯爵家族于1384年将布格多夫与图恩卖给伯尔尼。布格多夫保有自己的议会和法庭，并逐渐在邻近村庄取得土地与权利。1706年的大火摧毁了上城大片建筑，1715年下城又遭火灾。1798年法国入侵以及赫尔维蒂共和国的改革，结束了这里的大部分旧有特权制度。

english: Off Newfoundland's south coast, Burgeo Bank faces a shore of islands, narrow harbours and rocky passages. The Burgeo Islands shelter coves behind their outer rocks, while the Ramea Islands lie to the east. On 5 August 1766, James Cook observed a solar eclipse from one of the Burgeo Islands during his survey; the observation helped establish the islands' longitude.
simp_chinese: 伯吉奥浅滩位于纽芬兰南岸外，面向遍布岛屿、狭窄港湾和岩礁水道的海岸。伯吉奥群岛外侧的礁石为内侧海湾提供遮蔽，拉米亚群岛则位于东方。1766年8月5日，詹姆斯·库克在勘测期间从伯吉奥群岛的一座岛上观测日食，这次观测帮助确定了群岛的经度。

english:
Burghausen stands on the Salzach beneath a long castle stretching along the ridge above the town. From 1255 it was a second residence of the dukes of Lower Bavaria, and it grew wealthy from salt brought downriver from Hallein and transferred to land transport. Its position as a ducal residence and trading centre gave the town a prominence reflected in the expansion of its castle.

Under the wealthy dukes Heinrich XVI, Ludwig IX and Georg, Burghausen flourished as the second capital of Bavaria-Landshut. After the Landshut War of Succession it became an administrative centre of reunited Bavaria in 1505. The ducal salt monopoly established in 1594 deprived the town of an important source of income, and the wars of the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries brought further losses.
simp_chinese:
布格豪森位于萨尔察赫河畔，城镇上方的山脊上延伸着一座长长的城堡。1255年起，这里成为下巴伐利亚公爵的第二驻地；哈莱因的盐沿河运来，在此卸船转运陆路，使城镇富裕起来。公爵驻地和贸易中心的地位，也体现在城堡的扩建上。

在富有的海因里希十六世、路德维希九世和格奥尔格三位公爵统治下，布格豪森作为巴伐利亚—兰茨胡特的第二首府迎来繁荣。兰茨胡特继承战争后，1505年它成为重新统一的巴伐利亚的行政中心之一。1594年建立的公爵食盐专卖，夺去了城镇一项重要收入；十七、十八世纪的战争又带来进一步损失。

english: Burglengenfeld lies on the Naab north of Regensburg, beneath a castle whose name appears in a record of 1205. The future Emperor Ludwig IV lived at the castle for about two years around 1300. An iron hammer at nearby Kai was recorded in 1387 as a member of the Upper Palatinate ironworkers' association. After the Landshut War of Succession the town passed to the new duchy of Palatinate-Neuburg, and in 1542 it received town rights and a coat of arms.
simp_chinese: 布格伦根费尔德位于雷根斯堡以北的纳布河畔，城上堡垒的名称见于1205年的记载。未来的皇帝路德维希四世约在1300年前后曾于城堡居住两年。1387年的记载提到，附近凯伊的一座铁锤坊是上普法尔茨铁工联合会的成员。兰茨胡特继承战争后，城镇归属新建的普法尔茨—诺伊堡公国；1542年，它获得城市权与纹章。

english: El Burgo de Osma grew beside its cathedral as the seat of the bishops of Osma, below the older fortified town across the river. Its Gothic cathedral and ecclesiastical buildings gave the small settlement an importance beyond its size. In the sixteenth century Bishop Pedro de Montoya strengthened the town's walls, supported a hospital for poor people and pilgrims, and advanced work on the cathedral. The University of Santa Catalina, founded in 1550, added a centre of learning to the bishopric.
simp_chinese: 埃尔布尔戈德奥斯马作为奥斯马主教驻地，在大教堂旁发展起来，河对岸则是较早的设防城镇。哥特式大教堂及教会建筑使这座小聚落拥有超越其规模的地位。十六世纪，主教佩德罗·德蒙托亚加强城墙，资助接待穷人和朝圣者的医院，并推进大教堂工程。1550年创建的圣卡塔利娜大学又为主教区增添了一处学术中心。

english:
Burhanpur stands on the north bank of the Tapti River in Khandesh, south of the fortified pass of Asirgarh. In 1388 the Faruqi ruler Malik Nasir Khan named the town for the Sufi saint Burhan-ud-Din and made it his capital. Under his successor Miran Adil Khan II, who built a citadel and palaces, Burhanpur grew into a major centre of trade and textile production.

Akbar annexed Khandesh in 1601 and made Burhanpur the capital of a Mughal province. Its governor Abdul Rahim Khan-i-Khanan provided the city with a new water supply and gardens. Prince Parviz chose it as his headquarters in the Deccan, and Shah Jahan spent much time here and added to the Shahi Qila palace. His wife Mumtaz Mahal died in Burhanpur giving birth to their fourteenth child and was first buried here before her remains were moved. In the eighteenth century the city came under Maratha control; it passed to the British in 1818.
simp_chinese:
布尔汉普尔坐落在坎德什的塔普蒂河北岸，北方是阿西尔加尔堡扼守的山口。1388年，法鲁基统治者马利克·纳西尔汗以苏菲圣人布尔汉丁之名命名此城，并将它设为都城。他的继任者米兰·阿迪勒汗二世修建城堡与宫殿，布尔汉普尔在其统治下发展为重要的贸易和纺织中心。

1601年阿克巴吞并坎德什，以布尔汉普尔为莫卧儿行省首府。总督阿卜杜勒·拉希姆·汗为城市修建了新的供水设施和花园。帕尔维兹王子将此地作为他在德干的驻地，沙贾汗也曾在这里长住并扩建沙希堡宫殿。他的妻子蒙塔兹·玛哈尔在布尔汉普尔生下第十四个孩子时去世，遗体最初葬于此地，后来才迁走。十八世纪城市转入马拉塔人手中，1818年又被移交给英国人。

english: Buri lies among the Dahlak Islands, close to Dahlak Kebir in the Red Sea. Ancient cisterns helped the islanders collect water in this hot, dry setting, while an Islamic cemetery preserves inscriptions dating from at least 912. Dahlak Kebir was the centre of a Muslim sultanate whose reach included parts of the nearby African coast.
simp_chinese: 布里位于红海的达赫拉克群岛，靠近达赫拉克凯比尔岛。古老蓄水池帮助岛民在炎热干旱的环境中收集水源，伊斯兰墓地保存的碑铭至少可追溯至912年。达赫拉克凯比尔曾是一个穆斯林苏丹国的中心，其势力范围也包括附近非洲海岸的一部分。

english:
Buriari is associated with Bonaire, a dry island off the northern coast of South America. Its low hills, salt ponds and reefs formed the setting for Caquetío communities whose connections reached the mainland. The Spanish arrived at the end of the fifteenth century and later forced Indigenous islanders to Hispaniola as laborers.

The Dutch took Bonaire in the seventeenth century, after capturing nearby Curaçao. Salt and valuable dyewood drew their attention to an island with very little fresh water. Under Dutch rule enslaved people were made to work in the salt pans, producing a valuable commodity for the growing Atlantic trade. Bonaire changed hands during the long wars of the revolutionary and Napoleonic era before returning to Dutch control in 1816.
simp_chinese:
布里亚里与南美洲北岸外的干燥岛屿博奈尔有关。低丘、盐池和珊瑚礁构成卡克蒂奥社群的生活环境，他们与大陆保持联系。西班牙人十五世纪末抵达，后来强迫原住民岛民前往伊斯帕尼奥拉劳作。

十七世纪，荷兰人夺取附近的库拉索后占领博奈尔。盐与染料木吸引他们关注这座淡水稀少的岛屿。荷兰统治下，被奴役的人被迫在盐池劳作，为大西洋贸易生产珍贵商品。革命与拿破仑战争期间，博奈尔几度易手，1816年回到荷兰控制之下。

english: The narrow Burica Peninsula projects south into the Pacific, between the coasts of Costa Rica and Panama.
